description: You are adept at assaulting the minds of your victims.
benefit: if a power you manifest deals damage to a mental ability score (such as ego whips damage to charisma), you may expend your psionic focus as part of manifesting that power. if you do, it instead deals damage to the mental ability score of your choice.

name: Quicken Power
description: You can manifest a power with a moments thought. Using this feat increases the power point cost of the power by 6. The powers total cost cannot exceed your manifester level. Manifesting a quickened power does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Manifesting a power can be nearly effortless for you. Normal A quickened power that normally has a manifesting time of 1 standard action can instead be manifested as a swift action.
benefit: you can manifest any power as a swift action, regardless of its normal manifesting time. if a target provokes an attack of opportunity from you, you can target it with a quickened power as your attack of opportunity. only quickened powers with a specific number of targets (rather than effect or area) can be manifested as an attack of opportunity, and only the creature that provoked the attack is targeted by the power (regardless of how many creatures the power normally targets). alternatively, you may expend two uses of mythic power to manifest a power as a quickened power (gaining only the normal of a quickened power, rather than the increased outlined above) without increasing the number of power points spent or expending psionic focus.

name: Redirect Power
description: You can direct a failed power against a different target.
benefit: to use this feat, you must expend your psionic focus. whenever a redirecting power targeting a single creature has no effect on its intended target (whether due to power resistance or a successful saving throw) you may, as a swift action, redirect it to target another eligible creature within range. the redirected power behaves in all ways as if its new target were the original target for the power. powers that affect a target in any way (including a lesser effect from a successful saving throw) may not be redirected in this manner. using this feat does not increase the power point cost of the power.

name: Rime Power
description: Creatures damaged by your powers with the cold descriptor become entangled. This feat can only be used with powers that have the cold descriptor and deal damage. Using this feat does not increase the power point cost of the power.
benefit: to use this feat, you must expend your psionic focus. the frost of your cold power clings to the target, impeding it for a short time. a rime power causes creatures that take cold damage from the power to become entangled for a number of rounds equal to the original level of the power.

name: Riposte Power
description: You can manifest a power in response to an attack.
benefit: to use this feat, you must expend your psionic focus. you can manifest a riposte power as an immediate action against a target that has just attacked you or forced you to make a save against an ability, power, or spell. using this feat increases the power point cost of the power by 4. the powers total cost cannot exceed your manifester level.

name: Selective Power
description: Your allies need not fear friendly fire. Powers that do not have an area of effect cannot be used with this feat.
benefit: to use this feat, you must expend your psionic focus. when manifesting a selective power with an area effect, you can choose a number of targets in the area equal to your key ability modifier. these targets are excluded from the effects of your power. using this feat increases the power point cost of the power by 2. the powers total cost cannot exceed your manifester level.

name: Shared Power
description: Alternatively, you can expend your psionic focus to treat the power as if it has a range of Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels) and has the network descriptor. Using this feat in this manner increases the power point cost of the power by 2. The powers total cost cannot exceed your manifester level.
benefit: to use this feat, you must expend your psionic focus. you can manifest a power with a range of personal as if the range was instead touch. using this feat in this manner does not increase the power point cost of the power.

name: Sickening Power
description: You can sicken creatures with your powers. Powers that do not inflict damage cannot be used with this feat.
benefit: to use this feat, you must expend your psionic focus. you can modify a power to sicken a creature damaged by the power. when a creature takes damage from this power, they become sickened for a number of rounds equal to the level of the power. if the power allows a saving throw, a successful save negates the sickening effect. if the power does not allow a save, the target can make a fortitude save to negate the sickening effect. if the power effect also causes the creature to become sickened, the duration of this metapsionic effect is added on to the duration of the power. using this feat increases the power point cost of the power by 2. the powers total cost cannot exceed your manifester level.

name: Split Psionic Ray
description: You can affect two targets with a single ray. Using this feat increases the power point cost of the power by 2. Your rays affect multiple targets.
benefit: when manifesting a power affected by split psionic ray, it can affect an additional number of targets equal to one third of your mythic tier (rounded down) and the range between targets increases by 5 feet for each mythic tier you have achieved. alternatively, you may expend one use of mythic power to manifest a power as a split ray power (gaining only the normal of a split ray power, rather than the increased outlined above) without increasing the number of power points spent or expending psionic focus.

name: Through the Flesh
description: You can chain a telepathy power when using a psychometabolism power.
benefit: to use this feat, you must expend your psionic focus. you manifest a psychometabolism power that targets a single creature and as a free action, you can manifest a telepathy power that targets the same creature. using this feat increases the power point cost of the power by 2. the powers total cost (psychometabolism and telepathy together) cannot exceed your manifester level.

name: Thundering Power
description: You can conjure your powers into existence with blaring thunder or fearful shrieks, deafening creatures damaged by their effects. Powers that do not inflict damage cannot be used with this feat.
benefit: to use this feat, you must expend your psionic focus. you can modify a power to deafen a creature damaged by the power. when a creature takes damage from this power, it becomes deafened for a number of rounds equal to the level of the power. if the power allows a saving throw, a successful save negates the deafening effect. if the power does not allow a save, the target can make a fortitude save to negate the deafening effect. if the power effect also causes the creature to become deafened, the duration of this metapsionic effect is added to the duration of the power. using this feat increases the power point cost of the power by 2. the powers total cost cannot exceed your manifester level.

name: Timeslipped Power
description: You can shift powers out of the timestream before they take effect, delaying their effect until needed.
benefit: to use this feat, you must expend your psionic focus. you manifest a personal psionic power and slip it out of the timestream, which means it stops existing just before activating. activating a timeslipped power takes a swift action, at which point the power acts as if you had just manifest it. using this feat increases the power point cost of the power by 8. you can only have one timeslipped power per five manifester levels. the powers total cost cannot exceed your manifester level.

name: Toppling Power
description: Your powers with the force descriptor knock the affected creatures prone. A toppling power only affects powers with the force descriptor. Using this feat does not increase the power point cost of the power.
benefit: to use this feat, you must expend your psionic focus. the impact of your force power is strong enough to knock the target prone. if the target takes damage, fails its saving throw, or is moved by your force power, make a trip check against the target, using your manifester level plus your manifesting ability score bonus (wisdom for psychic warriors, intelligence for psions, and so on). this does not provoke an attack of opportunity. if the check fails, the target cannot attempt to trip you or the force effect in response.

name: Transcendent Power
description: Your psionic abilities cross over into the realm of magic Manifesting a Transcendent power costs 2 additional power points, and the total cost cannot exceed the characters manifester level.
benefit: to use this feat, a character must expend their psionic focus. the power manifested using this feat is treated as a magic spell of no particular school for all purposes (feats, class abilities area effects, spell resistance, etc.). this does not allow metamagic feats to be applied to the power.

name: Twin Power
description: You can manifest a power simultaneously with another power just like it. Using this feat increases the power point cost of the power by 6. The powers total cost cannot exceed your manifester level. You can split the effects of a twinned power.
benefit: when manifesting a twinned power, you can choose separate targets or areas for the two effects. alternatively, you may expend two uses of mythic power to manifest a power as a twinned power (gaining only the normal of a twinned power, rather than the increased outlined above) without increasing the number of power points spent or expending psionic focus.

name: Unconditional Power
description: Disabling conditions do not hold you back. Only personal powers and powers that affect your person can be manifested as unconditional powers. Using this feat increases the power point cost of the power by 8. The powers total cost cannot exceed your manifester level. You can manifest powers under nearly any condition. Normal Only personal powers and powers that affect your person can be manifested as unconditional powers.
benefit: you can manifest any power as an unconditional power and under any status effect except unconscious or dead. alternatively, you may expend two uses of mythic power to manifest a power as an unconditional power (gaining only the normal of an unconditional power, rather than the increased outlined above) without increasing the number of power points spent or expending psionic focus.

name: Unwilling Teleport
description: You can use psychoportation powers on a target you wouldnt normally be able to effect. Special This feat does not work with powers that have an augmentation option that allows them to target unwilling creatures.
benefit: to use this feat, you must expend your psionic focus. you may manifest a psychoportation power with a target of willing creatures on an unwilling creature within line of sight. the creature gets a will saving throw (dc 10 + the powers level + your main manifesting abilitys modifier) to avoid the effect. using this feat increases the power point cost of the power by 6. the powers total cost cannot exceed your manifester level. this feat follows the standard rules of teleportation, in that the teleported creature cannot be teleported upwards into the air or into objects or other creatures. the target creature must be teleported onto a clear, supported surface. attempts to teleport a creature outside these rules always fail.

name: Void Power
description: You manifest powers that deal damage of the void instead of an energy type.
benefit: to use this feat, you must expend your psionic focus. when you manifest a power that deals damage of your active energy type, but instead of using your active energy type, it draws upon the void itself, creating an inverse of energy. the power deals the same amount of damage, but this damage is untyped and not subject to energy resistance. using this feat increases the power point cost of the power by 4. the powers total cost cannot exceed your manifester level.

name: Widen Power
description: You can increase the area of your powers. Using this feat increases the power point cost of the power by 4. The powers total cost cannot exceed your manifester level. You can manifest powers that cover vast areas. Normal A widened power increases its area by 100%.
benefit: when you manifest a power affected by widen power, any numeric measurements of the powers area increase by 200%. only a burst, emanation, or spread-shaped power can be affected by this feat. alternatively, you may expend a use of mythic power to manifest a power as a widened power (gaining only the normal of a widened power, rather than the increased outlined above) without increasing the number of power points spent or expending psionic focus.

name: Extra Arm
description: Your projected form has an additional appendage compared to a normal humanoid. Special This feat can be taken up to twice. When it is taken a second time, your projected form gains a fourth arm. This feat qualifies you as having three arms for feats such as Multiweapon Fighting.
benefit: your projected form possess three arms. you can wield multiple weapons, but only one hand is your primary hand, and all others are off hands. you can also use your hands for other purposes that require free hands. this additional arm is always projected with your form, and cannot be turned off though use of alter self can potentially hide it.

name: Extra Future Visions
description: You can see the future more often. Special This feat can be taken multiple times. Its
benefit: (editor's note the feat ends abruptly here. i assume it was supposed to say "its stack.")

name: Fast Friends
description: You are better at fusion than most mineralites.
prerequisites: fusion of forms racial trait, base attack bonus +5
benefit: so long as all the contributors of a fusion of forms possess this feat, they may perform the fusion as a standard action. additionally, if participants possessing this feat are in a fusion of forms with others who dont when the fusion falls apart, the possessors of this feat may make a dc 20 will saving throw. all contributors with this feat that make the saving throw remain in their own fusion instead of breaking into individuals. the new fusion still suffers the normal consequence of the original fusion falling apart.

name: Flexibility of Mind
description: You can retrain faster than humanoids because you can redesign your projected form.
benefit: whenever you wish to retrain a feat or class feature, you may dissipate your form instead. you must remain this way for 1 hour per day you would normally spend retraining. at the end of the time, your retraining is complete and you reform. if you retrain using this method, you must wait 1 week before you use it again.

name: Force Caster
description: Your command over force and force-effects create longer-lasting spell effects.
prerequisites: caster level 1st, projected form racial trait.
benefit: when you cast spells with the force descriptor, you are considered two levels higher when determining the duration of those spells.

name: Fusion Arms
description: You keep your projected weapons or armor in fusion form. Additionally, so long as at least two contributors possess this feat, the fusion may take the 3-point Amalgam Weapon evolution.
benefit: any participants of a fusion of forms with this feat may keep their projected weapons or armor (including gembound ones) while in the fusion form. the fusion is considered proficient with any weapons or armor kept this way. if two of the same type of item would be kept by multiple members in the fusion, like two mineralites each bonding with armor, the fusion can choose a single armor to project which can be either of the members armors, or an amalgamation of them all. add all related bonuses together and divide those numbers by the number of items in the mix (rounded down). for instance, mundane leather armor (+2 armor bonus) and plate mail +2 (+9 armor bonus, +2 enhancement bonus) fused would grant a +5 armor bonus and +1 enhancement bonus to ac. keep only an appropriate number of special properties in the case of magic arms and armor available for the new fused bonus. these fusions arms and armors are always sized correctly for the fusion form. only weapon or armor can be included, not tools or other consumables like magic potions, etc.

name: Gem Companion
description: Your companion is shardborn.
prerequisites: familiar, animal companion, or mount class features.
benefit: your companion looks like any other member of their kind, except for the magical chunk of gemstone in their body. your companion gains the shardborn template. should you ever desire to change your companion, this companion changes into the new form instead of being dismissed and replaced. this specifically allows companions that are not the animal or magical beast type to gain the shardborn template, but only for so long as they are a characters companion.

name: Greater Holographic Resistance
description: Your training has helped you to realize your body is nothing but projected light. Special You may take this feat multiple times. Each time, choose a different condition you are immune to.
benefit: choose one condition disease, mind-affecting effects, poison, fatigue or exhaustion. you are now immune to those types of effects. you lose this immunity when targeted by a deeper darkness or similar higher level spell with the darkness descriptor.

name: Improved Holographic Resistance
description: You are training yourself to realize your body is nothing but projected light.
benefit: your racial resistance bonuses increases to +5, and you only lose these bonuses when targeted deeper darkness or similar higher level spell with the darkness descriptor.

name: Improved Projected Weapons
description: Your projected weapons are more powerful magic items. This bonded weapon can still be dispelled as a normal projected weapon, but you add its overall enhancement bonus to the DC to dispel it. If a weapon bonded with you is dispelled, it cant be reformed for at least 24 hours, 8 hours of which you must rest and meditate to reform the weapon in your mind. If a weapon bonded with you is destroyed, you lose the use of this ability for 30 days, or until you gain a level, whichever comes first. During this 30-day period, you take a 1 penalty on all attack and weapon damage rolls.
prerequisites: con 15, projected weapon racial trait, projected form adept, improved holographic resistance
benefit: your projected weapon counts as masterwork version of the type of weapon it is, granting a +1 enhancement bonus to attack. when youve attained a character level of 5th, your projected weapon gains a +1 enhancement bonus as a magic weapon. for every three levels beyond 5th, the weapon gains another +1 enhancement bonus, to a maximum of +6 at 20th level. these bonuses can be added to the weapon, stacking with existing weapon bonuses to a maximum of +5, or they can be used to add any of the following weapon properties axiomatic, brilliant energy, defending, keen, and speed. adding these properties consumes an amount of bonus equal to the propertys cost. these bonuses are added to any properties the weapon already has (if using a gembound weapon), but duplicate abilities do not stack. if the weapon is not magical, at least a +1 enhancement bonus must be added before any other properties can be added. the projected weapon imparts no bonuses if the weapon is held by anyone other than the original owner, but resumes giving bonuses if returned to the them. these bonuses apply to only one end of a double weapon.

name: Leverage Self-Worth
description: You can use the value of your gemstone as a material component in spells, at a cost.
prerequisites: ability to cast spells, gemstone form racial trait
benefit: you learned how to leverage the value of your gemstone against the material costs of your spells. when casting a spell with a costly material component, you can negate up to 500 gp worth of material component cost per character level you have. if you do so, your gemstone takes 1d4 points of damage. this damage bypasses hardness and any effects that would normally prevent damage. this damage cannot be repaired for 24 hours.

name: Magical Gemstone
description: You can tap inherent magical potential in your gemstone as spell-like ability. Special This feat may be taken multiple times. Each time you take this feat, the level of spell you may select from increases by 1, to a maximum of 3rd level spells.
benefit: select one cantrip from the sorcerer/wizard spell list. you can cast this spell 3/day as a spell-like ability.

name: Mind Over Photons
description: You understand that your body is nothing but light, and thus need not be affected by every ill or harm done to it.
prerequisites: con 17, life as photons racial trait, greater holographic resistance
benefit: for any fortitude saving throw you make, you may roll twice and take the more favorable result.

name: Photon Caster
description: Your command over light and photons create longerlasting spell effects.
prerequisites: caster level 1st, life as photons racial trait.
benefit: when you cast spells with the light descriptor, you are considered two levels higher when determining the duration of those spells.

name: Principles of Mindfulness
description: Your thoughtfulness for others aids you in remaining in fusion forms.
benefit: you are mindful of your thoughts and emotions and how they affect others. whenever you are a contributor into a fusion of forms, that fusion gains a +5 morale bonus to saving throws to maintain the fusion. a contributor can only take this feat once, but the bonuses from multiple contributors with this feat stack.

name: Quartz Determination
description: You show a perseverance similar to those living creatures with the Diehard feat. When using this feat, you are staggered. You can take a move action without further injuring yourself, but if you perform any standard action (or any other action deemed as strenuous, including some swift actions, such as casting a quickened spell) you take 1 point of damage after completing the act (affecting your gemstone, automatically bypassing any hardness or other reduction in damage it may normally have). If your negative hit points are equal to or greater than your Constitution score, your projected form dissipates as you retreat to your gemstone. Normal A mineralite without this feat who is reduced to negative hit points dissipates their projected from, reverting into their gemstone form.
benefit: when your hit point total is below 0, but your projected form does not dissipate, and you automatically stabilize. you do not need to make a constitution check each round to avoid losing additional hit points. you may choose to act as if you were disabled. you must make this decision as soon as you are reduced to negative hit points (even if it isnt your turn). if you do not choose to act as if you were disabled, your projected form slumps over and you appear (and are treated as being) unconscious.

name: Quick Reform
description: You are able to reform your projections faster than most mineralites. Special When used with Flexibility of Mind feat, you can retrain once per day instead of once per week, and it only takes you 10 minutes per day of normal retraining instead of 1 hour per. Normal Under normal conditions, you must wait till you would have fully healed all of your hit points to reproject your self from your gemstone if it dissipated from damage.
benefit: you can regain your projected form faster than most mineralites after it is winked out of existence involuntarily. if you lost your projected from from normal damage, you can reproject your body as soon as you have at least 1 hp. if your projected form was destroyed by some other means, like being dispelled or disintegrated, and you normally have to wait an amount of time before you could reproject, reduce this time by a factor of 10, so that 10 rounds becomes 1 round, 10 minutes becomes 1 minute, 60 minutes becomes 6 minutes, 24 hours becomes 2 hours 40 minutes, etc.

name: Strength of Diamonds
description: You have an especially resilient gemstone. Special You may take this feat multiple times, its effects stack for a maximum hardness of 30 and +30 hp to your gemstone.
benefit: your gemstone is tougher than most. your mineralite gemstones hardness and hit points increases by 5.

name: Projected Form Adept
description: You have great control over your projected form. Special No matter what final form you take, your gemstone is always located in the same basic location on your body (though additional mundane or magical means can still hide it). Additionally, the unnatural nature of your skin tone, hair, and other traits always shows through so that you take a -5 penalty on all Disguise checks.
benefit: you are able to make more substantial changes to your projected form, as if using alter self at-will instead of disguise self and vocal alteration. you retain those spell-like abilities as well.

name: Bestial Projected Form
description: You are able to alter your projected form into that of an animal-like creature. Additionally, no matter what final form you take, your gemstone is always located in the same basic location on your body (though additional mundane or magical means can still hide it). Additionally, the unnatural nature of your skin tone, hair, and other traits always shows through so that you take a -5 penalty on all Disguise checks.
benefit: special druids with this feat may only apply their special of wild shaping to their limited forms per day, but are able to still use the basic spell with this feat at-will.

name: Improved Bestial Projected Form
description: Your animal-like projected form becomes stronger. Special This feat can be taken multiple times, each time increasing the required minimum Constitution score by 2 points, and increasing the level of beast shape. So Con 17 for beast shape iii, and Con 19 for beast shape iv.
prerequisites: con 17, bestial projected form, projected form adept
benefit: you now use beast shape ii at-will instead of beast shape i.

name: Draconic Projected Form
description: You are able to alter your projected form into that of a dragonlike creature. Additionally, no matter what final form you take, your gemstone is always located in the same basic location on your body (though additional mundane or magical means can still hide it). Additionally, the unnatural nature of your skin tone, hair, and other traits always shows through so that you take a -5 penalty on all Disguise checks.
prerequisites: con 19, bestial projected form, improved bestial projected form, projected form adept
benefit: special druids with this feat may only apply their special of wild shaping to their limited forms per day, but are able to still use the basic spell with this feat at-will.

name: Monstrous Projected Form
description: You are able to alter your projected form to have monstrous features. Additionally, no matter what final form you take, your gemstone is always located in the same basic location on your body (though additional mundane or magical means can still hide it). Additionally, the unnatural nature of your skin tone, hair, and other traits always shows through so that you take a -5 penalty on all Disguise checks.
benefit: special druids with this feat may only apply their special of wild shaping to their limited forms per day, but are able to still use the basic spell with this feat at-will.

name: Improved Monstrous Projected Form
description: Your monstrous projected form becomes stronger. Special This feat can be taken multiple times, each time increasing the required minimum Constitution score by 2 points, and increasing the level of monstrous physique. So Con 17 for monstrous physique iii, and Con 19 for monstrous physique iv.
prerequisites: con 17, monstrous projected form, projected form adept
benefit: you now use monstrous physique ii at-will instead of monstrous physique i.

name: Giant Projected Form
description: You are able to alter your projected form to massive sizes. Additionally, no matter what final form you take, your gemstone is always located in the same basic location on your body (though additional mundane or magical means can still hide it). Additionally, the unnatural nature of your skin tone, hair, and other traits always shows through so that you take a -5 penalty on all Disguise checks.
prerequisites: con 19, monstrous projected form, improved monstrous projected form, projected form adept
benefit: special druids with this feat may only apply their special of wild shaping to their limited forms per day, but are able to still use the basic spell with this feat at-will.

name: Plant-Like Projected Form
description: You are able to alter your projected form into that of a plant-like creature. Additionally, no matter what final form you take, your gemstone is always located in the same basic location on your body (though additional mundane or magical means can still hide it). Additionally, the unnatural nature of your skin tone, hair, and other traits always shows through so that you take a -5 penalty on all Disguise checks.
benefit: special druids with this feat may only apply their special of wild shaping to their limited forms per day, but are able to still use the basic spell with this feat at-will.

name: Improved Plant-Like Projected Form
description: Your plant-like projected form becomes stronger. Special This feat can be taken a second time, increasing the required minimum Constitution score to 19, and increasing the spell to plant shape iii.
prerequisites: con 17, plant-like projected form, projected form adept
benefit: you now use plant shape ii at-will instead of plant shape i.

name: Absolute Focus
description: You can convert psionic power into mental focus.
prerequisites: autohypnosis 3 ranks, focus powers class feature.
benefit: choose one focus power you know. you can expend your psionic focus when using the chosen focus power to reduce its cost in mental focus points by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

name: Access Psionic Talent
description: You are able to manifest minor psionic abilities. Special This feat may be selected more than once. Each time, you gain five additional psionic talents.
benefit: you gain five talents (level 0 powers). these talents can be from any class list.

name: Additional Teletechnique
description: You have unlocked another offensive teleportation secret.
prerequisites: benefit you gain one additional teletechnique. you must meet all the for this teletechnique. this feat may be taken multiple times.

name: Additional Terror
description: You have unlocked an additional form of fear. Special You may take this feat multiple times. Each time, you gain a new terror.
benefit: you gain an additional terror.

name: Advanced Anomalous Path
description: You have developed finer control over of your psionic animus.
prerequisites: wis 13; animus potency or extra animus; any metapsionic feat, warriors path class feature, manifester level 10th, base attack bonus +6.
benefit: the anomalous trance now applies to your touch armor class against powers, psi-like abilities, spells, and spell-like abilities. additionally, when using the anomalous path maneuver, the animus provided from this ability increases from 1d4 to 1d6 at 3rd level, and from 2d4 to 2d6 at 7th level. this feat is a supernatural ability.

name: Advanced Archer Path
description: You have expanded expertise at ranged combat.
prerequisites: point-blank shot, precise shot, archer path class feature, manifester level 10th, base attack bonus +6
benefit: half of the competence bonus from your archer trance is added to your damage rolls for attacks made with ranged or thrown weapons (natural weapons do not count for this ). in addition, when using the archer maneuver, you may perform a bull rush attempt instead of a trip attempt.

name: Advanced Ascetic Path
description: You are an expert of unarmed combat.
prerequisites: dodge, psionic dodge, ascetic path class feature, manifester level 10th, base attack bonus +6
benefit: the competence bonus of your ascetic trance now applies to both ac and saves. in addition, when using the ascetic maneuver, you can deflect one attack as if using the deflect arrows feat, although you may alternatively deflect a melee attack.

name: Advanced Assassin Path
description: Your attacks have become even deadlier.
prerequisites: deep impact, psionic weapon, assassin path class feature, manifester level 10th, base attack bonus +6
benefit: when using the assassin trance, you deal sneak attack as a rogue of half your psychic warrior level. your target must be eligible for sneak attack (not immune to precision-based damage, flanked, denied a dexterity bonus, etc). in addition, when using the assassin maneuver, your opponent must make a fortitude save (dc equal to 10 + your base attack bonus) or be staggered for a number of rounds equal to your wisdom modifier.

name: Advanced Brawling Path
description: Your grappling abilities are particularly effective.
prerequisites: improved grapple, improved unarmed strike, brawling path class feature, manifester level 10th, base attack bonus +6
benefit: when using the brawling trance, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your grapple checks for every three psychic warrior levels you have. in addition, when using the brawling maneuver, the damage you deal can be lethal, instead of non-lethal.

name: Advanced Constructs
description: You are especially skilled at creating astral constructs. Menu A Menu B Menu C
benefit: you gain additional menu options for astral constructs, as detailed below.

name: Advanced Dervish Path
description: You seem to float between enemies, a blur of destruction.
prerequisites: dex 15, double slice, two-weapon fighting, dervish path class feature, manifester level 10th, base attack bonus +6
benefit: when using the dervish trance, the competence bonus applies to your damage as well as your attack rolls. in addition, you can use the dervish maneuver even if you moved before your attack and you have no limit of how many 5-foot steps you can take while using the dervish maneuver, as long as you make at least one attack before each 5-foot step. the maximum distance you can move in this round is that of a double move.

name: Advanced Feral Path
description: Your natural attacks are more vicious.
prerequisites: psionic fist, unavoidable strike, feral path class feature, manifester level 10th, base attack bonus +6
benefit: the competence bonus from your trance now also applies to damage rolls made with natural attacks. in addition, when using the feral maneuver, if two natural attacks in the same charge are successful, your natural weapons deal extra damage. this damage is equal to the damage dealt by one natural attack plus 1-1/2 times your strength modifier (if the two natural attacks deal different amounts of damage, use the lesser of the two).

name: Advanced Gladiator Path
description: Youve developed keen tactical instincts and are able to leverage these with both mental and physical power.
prerequisites: wis 13; combat expertise, ready response; warriors path class feature, manifester level 10th, base attack bonus +6.
benefit: the gladiator path trance ability allows you to tactically reposition yourself whenever you fail a combat maneuver attempt against an enemy or an enemy fails a combat maneuver attempt against you, allowing you to move up to 5 feet as a free action without provoking attacks of opportunity (even if it isnt your turn). you may use the maneuver of this warriors path as part of an attack action you have made as a free action once per round. you must expend your psionic focus and you may immediately make a combat maneuver attempt (such as a disarm or grapple) as part of that attack action. this feat is a supernatural ability.

name: Advanced Hungering Path
description: You ever-hungry psionic scar holds greater demands for greater power.
prerequisites: con 13; psionic body or toughness; warriors focus; warriors path class feature, manifester level 10th, base attack bonus +6.
benefit: the hunger paths trance causes those who fail a saving throw against your powers or class abilities to become sickened for two rounds from the power of your aura. when using the maneuver, the ranged touch attack not only draws in psychic power, but it also life energies. in addition to the power point drain, the attack inflicts 1d6 points of damage at 3rd level, and this damage improves by 1d6 points of damage at 7th level and every four levels thereafter. you gain 5 temporary hit points for 10 points of damage inflicted by this attack. these temporary hit points last for one minute or until they are taken away by damage; further applications of this ability do not stack up additional temporary hit points. this feat is a supernatural ability.

name: Advanced Infiltrator Path
description: You have a talent for getting wherever you need to go.
prerequisites: deceitful, infiltrator path class feature, manifester level 10th, base attack bonus +6
benefit: when using the infiltrator trance, the competence bonus to disguise checks also applies to bluff and sense motive checks. in addition, when using the infiltrator maneuver, for the duration of your metamorphosis power, you gain the scent extraordinary ability and the competence bonus to intimidate checks also applies to survival checks.

name: Advanced Interceptor Path
description: You defend your allies with uncanny expertise.
prerequisites: combat expertise, interceptor path class feature, manifester level 10th, base attack bonus +6
benefit: when using the interceptor trance, you can take a penalty to your armor class equal to the competence bonus granted by the interceptor trance to grant a deflection bonus to armor class to one ally threatened by an enemy within your melee reach. in addition, when using the interceptor maneuver, if your attack was successful, you can make a free disarm or trip attempt against the enemy struck.

name: Advanced Mind Knight Path
description: You have learned enhanced techniques to make sure you are always armed and dangerous
prerequisites: wis 13, psionic meditation, psionic shot or psionic weapon, mind knight path class feature, manifester level 10th, base attack bonus +6
benefit: as long as you have both mind knight path powers, you can manifest both mind knight path powers at the same time as a single standard action. any time you manifest call weaponry, you may select one other 1st level power you know; you may manifest that power using martial power as if it were a path power, as long as the attack is made using the weapon summoned. in addition, when using the mind knight maneuver, you gain a +1 competence bonus on the attack rolls for every four psychic warrior levels you have.

name: Advanced Outrider Path
prerequisites: your ectoplasmic mount strikes at foes you pass. wis 13; mounted archery or ride-by attack; warriors focus, outrider path class feature, manifester level 10th, base attack bonus +6.
benefit: whenever you are riding the mount from your outrider trance and its movement takes you within 5 feet of an opponent during your turn, you may deal force damage equal to your wisdom modifier to that opponent. a given opponent can only take this damage once per round. this feat is a supernatural ability.

name: Advanced Survivor Path
description: You are capable of withstanding a variety of situations.
prerequisites: con 13, mind over body, toughness, survivor path class feature, manifester level 10th, base attack bonus +6
benefit: when using the survivor trance, you gain resistance to your active energy type. the resistance is equal to 5 for every four psychic warrior levels you have. in addition, when using the survivor maneuver, the bonus to will saves can instead apply to fortitude saves.

name: Advanced Weaponmaster Path
description: You are a particularly dangerous opponent to duel.
prerequisites: combat expertise, improved disarm, weapon focus, weaponmaster path class feature, manifester level 10th, base attack bonus +6
benefit: the competence bonus from your trance now also applies to damage rolls made with a weapon (natural attacks do not count for this purpose). in addition, when using the weaponmaster maneuver, you can choose to make a free disarm attempt against your attacker in place of the single melee attack. if your disarm attempt is successful, you may then make a single melee attack against your opponent in place of the 5-foot step.

name: Aligned Attack
description: Your melee or ranged attack overcomes your opponents alignment-based damage reduction and deals additional damage. As long as you maintain psionic focus, your attack is treated as either a good, evil, chaotic, or lawful attack (depending on your original choice) for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. You may choose to expend your psionic focus when making an attack to power this feats secondary ability. When you make a successful melee or ranged attack in this fashion, you deal an extra 2d6 points of damage of the type you originally selected if your target is of the opposed alignment. This attack is still treated as the appropriate alignment type. You must decide whether or not to use this ability prior to making an attack. If your attack misses, you still expend your psionic focus. You can switch the alignment of your attacks.
benefit: you can expend a use of mythic power as a swift action to change the alignment choice for the aligned attack feat. the alignment chosen must still match one of your alignment components.

name: Alternate Conscription
description: You've broadened your methods of conscripting enemies.
benefit: when you take this feat, you choose a method of conscription from a different set of highlord tenets. by expending your psionic focus as a free action, even if it isn't your turn, you may use the conscription ability of that tenet as if you were a highlord of that tenet for a round.

name: Amplified Momentum
description: You can amplify your augmented strikes with momentum, or recycle it into your evasiveness.
benefit: when you spend momentum to amplify an attack, you choose to gain one of the following

name: Animus Potency
description: You are capable of channeling animus into your psionic powers when you manifest them.
prerequisites: spellcraft 5 ranks, must possess an animus pool.
benefit: when you manifest a power that allows a saving throw, you can spend up 2 points of animus to increase its save dc by 1. at manifester level 8th and every four levels thereafter, you can spend an additional 2 points of animus to add an additional +1 to the save dc.

name: Armored Mind
description: Your mental resilience is psionically enhanced.
benefit: the of your enduring mind feat increase by 2 while you are psionically focused. you may expend your psionic focus as an immediate action to negate all mental ability damage from a single source (other than you) for 1 round.

name: Assassins Venom
description: The poisons you create are more effective.
prerequisites: base attack bonus +3, assassin warrior path, prevenom or prevenom weapon path power.
benefit: you gain a bonus on the save dc of prevenom and prevenom weapon equal to the competence bonus granted by your trance class feature.

name: Backtrack
description: Your parallel selves learn an old trick, even after opportunity had passed them by. Special You can take this feat multiple times; each time you do, you choose a different parallel action to learn.
benefit: you gain a voyager parallel action in a category of your class level or lower that you did not already possess.

name: Biokinetic Adept
description: You utilize biokinetic techniques when you gain your focus.
benefit: you may gain temporary hit points equal to 1/2 your manifester level whenever you gain your psionic focus. these temporary hit points last for up to one minute per character level. you may gain temporary hit points from this feat up to four times per day, and they do not stack with themselves.

name: Biokinetic Feedback
description: You convert your psychic enervation into physical feedback.
benefit: if you would lose power points as the result of psychic enervation, you may instead lose an equal number of hit points. additionally, if you possess the overchannel feat, you may use it in conjunction with your wild surge. the effects stack. combining your wild surge with overchannel in this manner increases your chance for psychic enervation by 20%.

name: Biokinetic Rhythms
description: You know how to heal your body with biokinetic techniques.
benefit: you may expend your psionic focus as a standard action to gain fast healing equal to your constitution modifier for 5 rounds. using this feat drains your bodys natural biorhythms; after activating this feat you must wait 10 minutes before activating it again.

name: Biokinetic Shielding
description: While focused, you enhance your form with biokinetic techniques.
benefit: you gain a natural armor bonus to your ac equal to your constitution modifier while psionically focused.

name: Biokinetic Surge
description: You can burn away long-term damage to your body.
prerequisites: biokinetic adept, con 13, wild surge class feature.
benefit: you may invoke your wild surge as a swift action to heal an amount of ability damage to your strength, dexterity, or constitution equal to your wild surges intensity. the first time per day that you use this feat, you do not need to check for psychic enervation. you check for psychic enervation as normal for each use thereafter.

name: Blink Ambush
description: You can surprise foes with your teleportation abilities. (Editor's Note "Slipstream Feint" does not exist. This was likely a feat that was removed before publishing)
benefit: once per round, when you teleport to or from a location within 10 feet of a creature, you can make a feint attempt against that creature as a free action (even if it isnt your turn). if your feint succeeds, you can expend your psionic focus to cause the target to become flat-footed for 1 round.

name: Blood Reveler
description: You delight in the pain inflicted by your lifeblood resonance.
benefit: once per round, when you deal damage to a creature with your lifeblood resonance, you may add your charisma modifier to the damage of the ability and gain temporary hit points equal to the damage dealt by it. at 8th and 15th levels, you can apply this effect to an additional use of your lifeblood resonance each round.

name: Body Fuel
description: You can expand your power point total at the expense of your health. You can recover additional power points for a proportional cost to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution. These recovered points are added to your power point reserve as if you had gained them by resting overnight. Special Only living creatures can use this feat. You can take advantage of this feat only while in your own body. You are able to selectively decide which ability to sacrifice for more power points.
benefit: when using the body fuel feat, you need only choose a single physical ability score (strength, dexterity, or constitution) to suffer ability burn, instead of all three.

name: Bookmark
description: You can leave an imprint behind for as long as you wish, for you to retreat to later.
prerequisites: afterimage class feature, rewind parallel action.
benefit: as a full-round action, you can set a semi-permanent afterimage on your current location. you can use rewind to return to this location instead of one of your normal afterimages as long as you are within a certain range of it, based on your character level (see below). this afterimage lasts until you rewind to it, or until you set another afterimage using this feat. this ability cannot cross planar boundaries; it only functions if you are still on the same plane as the bookmark.

name: Boost Construct
description: Your astral constructs have more abilities. Special This effect stacks with the Summoners Call ability of the shaper. Your astral constructs are creatures of legendary might and toughness.
benefit: any astral construct you create is considered mythic for the purpose of interacting with other mythic creatures. it doesnt gain any mythic abilities or powers, but is affected by mythic powers, spells, and abilities as if it were a 1st-tier mythic creature. additionally, if the astral construct has damage reduction, its damage reduction becomes dr/epic.

name: Bound Self
description: As a last-ditch effort, you may bind your own soul to your psicrystal preventing death at great cost. If your psicrystal is destroyed while you possess any negative levels gained from Bound Self, you must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC equal to 10 + your manifester level) or die instantly.
prerequisites: bound spirit, psicrystal affinity, spirited psicrystal, manifester level 15th.
benefit: special if you are immune to negative levels, you may not from this feat.

name: Bound Sigil
description: The sigils of your manifesting can be drawn on your body and activated later.
benefit: you can now draw your sigils on your body so that they etch themselves into you. 3 times per day you can manifest a power and turn it into a psionic tattoo on your body instead of having it manifest normally.

name: Bound Spirit
description: By binding a willing spirit to your psicrystal, you grant further power to yourself and enhanced survivability to it.
prerequisites: psicrystal affinity, spirited psicrystal, manifester level 10th.
benefit: three times per day, while the spirit is bound within your psicrystal, you may draw on its essence for power choosing one of the following abilities. each of these abilities takes a standard action to activate, is a psi-like effect, and functions at your manifester level. for each bonus you take, you owe one of the following to the spirit, to be paid within the next 24 hours a part of your dreams (you must rest one additional hour to regain power points), some of your memories (you must spend one uninterrupted hour doing nothing but sitting and reminiscing), or a part of your soul (you gain one negative level). if you do not pay the spirit within the next 24 hours, you lose all of this feat and cannot from it again for one week.

name: Broken Dreams Style
description: Your unarmed strikes are empowered by nightmares.
prerequisites: devastating touch class feature, improved unarmed strike, intimidate 3 ranks
benefit: when performing an unarmed attack, you can choose to also deliver your devastating touch damage through that attack.

name: Brutal Surge
description: You are able to manifest powers using your anger to a greater degree.
prerequisites: ability to manifest a rage blade, ability to manifest 1st level powers from the gifted blade list.
benefit: you may treat the enhancement bonus increase from your rage blade as the wild surge class feature (see wilder base class for details) on powers that you manifest. you spend one round of your rage blade usage and initiate a wild surge and risk psychic enervation as per the wilder class (using the brutality blades enervation penalty).

name: Cerebric Guardian
description: You have bound a powerful spirit to your psicrystal, gaining a servant that grows as you do. A cerebric guardian is treated the same as a psicrystal for the purpose of stats and advancement, with the following changes. Piece of Mind (Ex) A cerebric guardian is invisible and cannot interact with or be interacted with by any creature other than its owner. It is always treated as adjacent to its owner, and cannot be targeted by or included in any effect not originating from its owner. This ability replaces flight. This ability modifies deliver touch powers. Form of Fear (Su) At 13th level, you may use manifest mind one additional time each day. When you use manifest mind, any enemy within 20 feet of the astral construct must succeed at a Will save (DC 13 + the primary manifesting ability score modifier of your highest level manifesting class) or be shaken for 5 minutes or until the cerebric guardian is no longer in astral construct form, whichever happens first. This ability replaces sight link. Channel Power (Sp) This ability functions as normal, except that it only functions if the cerebric guardian is within 100 feet of you.
benefit: manifest mind (ps) at 7th level, once per day, you may manifest your cerebric guardian, just as if you were using astral construct, at a manifester level equal to 1/2 your hd. you spend power points to do so as normal, to a maximum of 1/2 your hd, but this is a supernatural effect and has a duration of 1 hour. while this astral construct exists, it counts as your cerebric guardian and can deliver touch powers for you, but loses all of the piece of mind ability. if your cerebric guardian is destroyed while in this form, you cannot use manifest mind again for 24 hours, you lose power points equal to your character level and are stunned for one round. this astral construct cannot venture more than 100 feet from you if it does so, the astral construct immediately disperses, returning your cerebric guardian to its original form.

name: Channel Rage
description: You have learned to focus your anger to fuel your wild surges.
prerequisites: wild surge class feature, rage class feature.
benefit: when you choose to power a manifestation with only your wild surge, you may spend 1 round of your rage instead of expending your psionic focus.

name: Collective Focus
description: You can store a psionic focus within your collectives minds for your use.
benefit: special you cannot from this feat at the same time as psicrystal containment or deep focus. if you have more than one of these, you may only have a single additional psionic focus at any given time.

name: Combat Manifestation
description: You are adept at manifesting powers in combat. You rarely lose concentration in combat.
benefit: the bonus from combat manifestation increases to +8. anytime you fail a concentration check, you do not lose the power points you were attempting to use. you do not manage to manifest the power, but the power points remains available for you to use at a later time. additionally if you successfully make a check to manifest a power defensively and the power requires a ranged attack roll, that ranged attack does not provoke an attack of opportunity.

name: Communal Overchannel
description: You burn the life force of others to strengthen your powers.
benefit: when you use the overchannel feat, you can instead have a member of your collective take the damage. they are allowed a will save to resist this effect (dc 10 + 1/2 manifester level + your manifesting ability modifier), in which case you take the damage as normal.

name: Condemning Glare
description: Your pretended judgments gain some true weight, promising true condemnation. Special You may not use both Condemning Glare and Words of Salvation on the same target within a 24-hour period.
benefit: when you succeed on a check to use the divine judgment feat, you may also attempt to use intimidate to demoralize the target as a free action (including the bonus from divine judgment). you may demoralize a creature normally immune to fear or mind-affecting effects in this way. once per day, while the target is demoralized by this effect, you may manifest aversion on that target as a psi-like ability, with a dc equal to 12 + your charisma modifier and a manifester level equal to your hd, ignoring normal immunities to mind-affecting effects.

name: Cortex Strike
description: You have learned how to overwhelm your enemies with a burst of energy just before your strike hits, allowing you to gain that final edge needed to strike a telling blow.
prerequisites: psicrystal affinity, psionic weapon, sneak attack +2d6, superior psicrystal (psicrystal weapon variant).
benefit: when you expend your psionic focus for the purpose of your psionic weapon feat with a psicrystal weapon, you can add your sneak attack damage to the regular +2d6 damage this feat provides, even if the creature isnt denied its dexterity bonus. this extra damage does not affect a creature immune to sneak attacks.

name: Countersurge
description: You can invoke your surge to disrupt powers and spells.
prerequisites: improved initiative, wild surge class feature, manifester level 6th.
benefit: you may invoke your wild surge as an immediate action in response to a power being manifested, or a spell being cast, within 100 feet of you. if you do, the source of the power or spell must succeed at a will save (dc 10 + 1/2 your manifester level + your charisma modifier) or that power or spell has its caster or manifester level (and, as a result, all effects dependent on caster or manifester level, such as damage and range) reduced by an amount equal to your wild surges intensity. if this would reduce the power or spells level below the minimum needed to cast it, that power or spell is still cast, though a spell or power with its caster level reduced to 0 or lower is negated and has no effect. using this feat increases your chance of psychic enervation by 20%. you must declare that you are using this feat after the power is manifested or the spell is cast, but before its results are determined.

name: Crippling Assault
description: You are able to paralyze the targets of your ranged and thrown attacks.
prerequisites: intimidating shot, point-blank shot, staggering shot, base attack bonus +11.
benefit: to use this feat, you must expend your psionic focus. as a standard action, you can make a ranged attack with a ranged or thrown weapon. if the attack is successful, it deals damage normally and forces the target to make a fortitude saving throw (dc 10 + 1/2 your character level + your wis modifier) or be paralyzed until the beginning of your next turn. this paralysis is only effective against dazed, flat-footed, paralyzed, staggered, stunned, or unconscious foes. if your attack misses, you still expend your psionic focus.

name: Critical Imbuement
description: You are able to recharge your psychic strike through truly potent attacks invigorating your confidence.
benefit: one per round when you make a successful critical hit you may recharge your psychic strike as a free action (even if it is not your turn).

name: Cushion the Blow
description: You reduce the damage of an attack on an ally. In addition, if you expend your psionic focus, you can reduce any additional damage on the attack (such as bonus damage from a high Strength or sneak attack damage) by your key ability modifier. You are able to block damage to multiple targets at once. Normal Using Cushion the Blow is an immediate action and only applies to a single member of your collective
benefit: you can share the effect of cushion the blow, greater cushion the blow, and improved cushion the blow to a number of members of your collective equal to your mythic tier. in addition, if you expend one use of mythic power, you can use cushion the blow as a free action even if it is not your turn.

name: Dancing Shadow Retribution
description: You have mastered the cloak dancers evasive combat style, blending in lightning fast strikes to your defensive dance.
prerequisites: cloak dance, dancing shadow style, dancing shadow waltz, ability to generate a mind blade, psychic strike +1d8, acrobatics 9 ranks, stealth 9 ranks.
benefit: when performing a cloak dance as a full round action, you gain total concealment and you may recharge your psychic strike while moving up to your base speed. when foes make attacks against you, these attacks provoke attacks of opportunity from you while youre under concealment from your cloak dance.

name: Dancing Shadow Style
description: Youve learned to turn your evasive combat style into a potent meditative technique.
prerequisites: cloak dance, ability to generate a mind blade, psychic strike +1d8, acrobatics 2 ranks, stealth 7 ranks
benefit: when performing a cloak dance (see the cloak dance feat), you may charge your psychic strike.

name: Dancing Shadow Waltz
description: Your evasive combat style allows you to move through danger without worry.
prerequisites: cloak dance, dancing shadow style, ability to generate a mind blade, psychic strike +1d8, acrobatics 5 ranks, stealth 7 ranks.
benefit: when performing a cloak dance as a full round action you may move up to your base speed while gaining concealment.

name: Deadly Imbuement
description: You are able to siphon off residual psychic impressions to recharge your psychic strike from fallen foes.
benefit: whenever you reduce a foe to 0 hit points or less, you may recharge your psychic strike as a free action once per round. foes slain in such a manner must possess an intelligence score of 3 or more for you to be able to recharge your psychic strike.

name: Deadly Throw
description: Your skill with thrown weapons allows you to replace power with finesse. Normal You add your Strength modifier to damage rolls for attacks made with thrown weapons. Your thrown attacks inflict additional damage.
benefit: you do not need to maintain psionic focus to gain the of deadly throw. if you are maintaining psionic focus while using deadly throw, you add half your mythic tier (round down, minimum 1) to your damage rolls made with thrown weapons.

name: Deep Focus
description: You have learned to focus your subconscious mind even while awake. Your subconscious minds focus is improved.
benefit: as long as you have at least one use of mythic power remaining or one power point remaining in your power point pool, you are always treated as if you are maintaining psionic focus for abilities powered by maintaining psionic focus. you may still only expend your psionic focus if you are actually maintaining psionic focus. in addition, you can expend a use of mythic power as a swift action to regain both your own and the psionic focus provided by deep focus.

name: Deep Impact
description: You can strike your foe with a melee weapon as if making a touch attack. Your weapon finds even the slightest of openings in an enemys defenses.
benefit: when you make an attack using deep impact, add half your tier (minimum 1) to the attack roll. in addition, you can expend a use of mythic power when using deep impact to treat all melee attacks made during your turn as melee touch attacks.

name: Deny the Lure
description: Your resistance against ghosts and spirits gains additional potential. You can expend your psionic focus as an immediate action when making a save against an effect created by an incorporeal creature to reroll the save, taking the new result. Use of this ability must be declared before the results of the roll are revealed.
benefit: when you use the resist the lure feat, you gain a +2 bonus on saves instead of +1 while you maintain psionic focus.

name: Disciple of Fear
description: You have studied the intricacies of terror and fear, being able to use this knowledge to further your own powers beyond what would normally be available for you.
prerequisites: devastating touch class feature, terrors class feature.
benefit: for the purpose of your devastating touch and terror class features, your effective class level increases by 4. this cant increase your effective class level to higher than your hit dice. however, even if you cant from the full bonus immediately, if you later gain hit dice in levels of other classes, you might be able to apply the rest of the bonus. this feat does not affect your terrors known or give you further uses of your terrors, but increases it for the purposes of augmentation and save dcs.

name: Dispelling Static
description: You can cause dispelled effects to make the target more prone to your powers. This does not affect psionic focus contained in psicrystals via Psicrystal Containment, unless the psicrystal is the target of the targeted dispel attempt.
benefit: if you make a successful targeted dispel check, you may choose to have the effect unravel violently, lashing the target of the dispel with psychic static that imposes a -1 penalty on saves against any power you manifest until the end of your next turn. the penalty increases by 1 for each effect dispelled. the target also loses any psionic focus it has and cannot regain psionic focus for 1 round.

name: Divert Perception
description: Your movement itself obscures your presence, allowing you to hide more easily. In addition, whenever you take a move action to move while psionically focused, you can expend your psionic focus in order to make a Stealth check to hide at the end of the movement, even if you do not have concealment or are observed. You remain hidden until the end of your next turn or until you break Stealth, whichever comes first. Normal You can move up to half your normal speed and use Stealth at no penalty. When moving at a speed greater than half but less than your normal speed, you take a 5 penalty. Its impossible to use Stealth while attacking, running, or charging.
benefit: you can move up to your speed and use stealth at no penalty. you can use stealth while running or charging with a 5 penalty.

name: Divine Judgement
description: Your words can cause fear and hope in even the dead, promising peace or judgment. This penalty for a given spirit decreases by one for each day that passes in which you do not attempt to control or deceive that spirit, to a minimum of 0.
benefit: you gain a +5 bonus on the first check you make to control or deceive a given spirit each day. if you succeed on this check, that spirit suffers a -2 penalty on saving throws against conduit powers and effects that you create for 24 hours. if you fail this check, any attempts you make to influence that ghost or spirit for the next week instead suffer a -5 penalty.

name: Dream Sovereign
description: You assert your influence over dreaming minds in numerous ways
prerequisites: ability to manifest dream message or induce nightmare
benefit: when you manifest either dream message or induce nightmare, you gain the ability to augment them in the following ways

name: Efficient Aid
description: Your ability to heal others at their request is more efficient. Normal The damage healed through the use of request aid is 3 hit points per power point spent. Your ability to heal others is significantly increased.
benefit: the damage healed through the use of request aid is increased by 50%. in addition, if you expend one use of mythic power, you can cure a number of points of ability damage equal to your mythic tier to the target. the target creature specifies which ability damage to heal.

name: Elemental Blast
description: You have learned how to convert your surge blast into elemental damage. Prerequsite Wild Surge +1, Surge Blast class feature
benefit: your surge blast deals damage of your active energy type instead of force damage. in addition, your surge blast is modified based upon your active energy type.

name: Empowered Shot
description: You can empower your ranged attacks, sending them farther.
benefit: as long as you maintain psionic focus, the range of your ranged weapons doubles. you may expend your psionic focus as part of a ranged attack (but not ranged touch attack) to ignore any penalties for range increment for that single attack. that attack still has its range doubled as if you were maintaining psionic focus.

name: Endowed Warp
description: You can endow your warp with a more concentrated focus.
benefit: to use this feat, you must expend your psionic focus. you add 1 to the save dc of your next warp attempt.

name: Enervation Fortitude
description: You have learned how to better handle psychic enervation. You are extremely resilient against psychic enervation.
benefit: when you suffer psychic enervation, you do not lose any hit points or power points, although you still suffer any additional effects like being stunned or sickened. in addition, you can expend one use of mythic power when you would suffer psychic enervation to negate the psychic enervation and instead gain surging euphoria.

name: Enhanced Steal Life
description: You make it more difficult for others to resist you stealing their life. You are skilled at extracting the life force out of other creatures.
benefit: the number of hit points gained when using steal life is increased by 50% (round down.) when using the steal life class feature, you can expend one use of mythic power. if the target makes a successful save against the attempt, you instead steal hit points as if you had used the steal health class feature

name: Enlarged Collective
description: Your collective has a longer range than normal. Normal The range of your collective is medium range (100 ft. + 10 ft. per class level), and the level at which your collective increase to unlimited and planar ranges are level 15 and level 19 respectively. Special If you have the Expansive Collective feat, use your total Hit Dice instead of your class level.
benefit: the range of your collective is now long range (400 ft. + 40 ft. per class level). additionally the range of your collective becomes unlimited at 12th level and planar at 16th level. at 19th level, if a member of your collective would be removed from the collective due to dying or their wisdom being reduced to 0, they remain in the collective for 24 hours, although they are still dead or have a 0 wisdom and remain unconscious, as appropriate. however, you do not suffer any penalties while they remain in your collective.

name: Expanded Collective
description: You are able to include more creatures into your collective. Normal Your collective can contain a number of creatures equal to half your class level or your key ability modifier, whichever is greater.
benefit: special you may take this feat multiple times; its stack.

name: Expanded Knowledge
description: You learn another power. Special You can gain this feat multiple times. Each time, you learn one new power at any level up to one less than the highest-level power you can manifest.
benefit: add to your powers known one additional power of any level up to one level lower than the highest-level power you can manifest. you can choose any power, including powers from another disciplines list or even from another classs list, even if that power is already on your classs power list.

name: Expanded Martial Power
description: You are able to use a wider selection of powers while making attacks. Normal When using martial power, you may only manifest path powers. Special You may still manifest path powers with martial power without expending psionic focus.
benefit: to use this feat, you must expend your psionic focus. when using the martial power ability, you can manifest any power you know, provided it is at least one lever lower than the highest level power you can manifest.

name: Expanded Strategies
description: You develop new strategies at a faster rate than most tacticians. Special You may take this feat multiple times. Each time, you gain a new strategy.
prerequisites: benefit you gain an additional strategy. you must meet all the of that strategy.

name: Expansive Collective
description: The power of your collective is unaffected by your other dabblings.
prerequisites: collective class feature, spirit of many class feature.
benefit: when calculating the range and number of creatures which may be joined to your collective, use your total hit dice instead of your class level.

name: Extended Blast
description: Your surge blast has a farther reach. Normal Your surge blast has a range of 30 feet.
benefit: your surge blast has a range of 60 feet.

name: Extended Crystalline Bond
description: Your psicrystal and phantom can remain merged for much longer than usual. Special You can take this feat multiple times. Its effects stack.
benefit: you can use your crystalline bond for 6 additional rounds per day.

name: Extra Blade Skill
description: Your training with a mind blade allows you to perform additional abilities. Special You may take this feat multiple times. Each time, you gain a new blade skill. You can meditate to gain a blade skill.
prerequisites: benefit each day, you can take 1 hour of meditation to decide how to focus your mythic energies. at the end of this time, select 1 blade skill for which you meet all the . you retain this blade skill until you next meditate on your mythic blade skill.
benefit: you gain an additional blade skill.

name: Extra Customization
description: Your astral suit can have additional customizations. Special You can gain this feat multiple times, but only one additional time for every five aegis levels you possess. You can meditate to gain additional customizations.
benefit: each day, you can take 1 hour of meditation to decide how to focus your mythic energies. at the end of this time, you gain one additional customization point to spend. you retain this customization point until you next meditate on your mythic customizations.

name: Extra Decree
description: You've expanded your highlord abilities. Special You may take this feat multiple times. Each time, you learn a new decree.
benefit: you learn a decree you qualify for.

name: Extra Disruption Type
description: You can have more active creature types with your disrupt pattern.
benefit: when you gain psionic focus, you can select one additional creature type as your active type.

name: Extra Gift
description: You can share more powers. Special You may take this feat multiple times. Each time, you choose another power you know.
benefit: choose another power that you know and add the network descriptor to it, as if by your gift of power class feature.

name: Extra Insight
description: You have unlocked a new insight. Special You can gain Extra Insight multiple times. You can meditate to gain additional insights.
prerequisites: benefit each day, you can take 1 hour of meditation to decide how to focus your mythic energies. at the end of this time, you gain one additional insight for which you meet all the . you retain this insight until you next meditate on your mythic insights.

name: Extra Power Known
description: You know an additional psionic power. Special You can gain this feat multiple times. Each time, you learn one new power from your class power list up to the highest-level power you can manifest.
benefit: add one additional power known of any level up to the highest-level power you can manifest to your powers known. you can only choose the power from your class power list.

name: Extra Reconfiguration
description: You are able to modify your astral suit more often. Your mythic energies grant you additional opportunities to reconfigure your astral suit.
prerequisites: extra reconfiguration. benefit you gain one additional daily use of your reconfigure ability. additionally, if you have no uses of reconfigure remaining, you may expend two uses of mythic power to use your reconfigure ability additionally, if you have no uses of reconfigure remaining, you may expend two uses of mythic power to use your reconfigure ability
benefit: you gain one additional daily use of your reconfigure class ability.

name: Extra Skipping Sill
description: You have unlocked a new skipping skill.
prerequisites: benefit you gain one additional skipping skill. you must meet all the for this skipping skill. this feat may be taken multiple times.

name: Extra Strategy
description: You gain extra daily uses of your strategy ability. Special You can gain this feat multiple times. Its effects stack. You are able to use your mythic energy to gain strategic opportunities.
benefit: you gain two additional daily uses of your strategy ability. additionally, if you have no uses of strategy remaining, you may expend one use of mythic power to use your strategy ability.

name: Extra Teletchniques
description: You can use your teletechniques more often than normal.
benefit: you gain 3 additional daily uses of your teletechniques. this feat may be taken multiple times. its effects stack. each time you take the feat, you gain three additional daily uses of your teletechniques.

name: Extra Terrors
description: You can use your terrors more than normal. Special You can gain Extra Terrors multiple times. Its effects stack. Each time you take the feat, you gain three additional daily uses of your terrors. Your mythic power allows you to inflict additional terrors.
benefit: you gain three additional daily uses of your terrors ability. additionally, if you have no uses of terrors remaining, you may expend one use of mythic power to use your terrors ability.

name: Extra Transfer
description: You can use transfer wounds more often. Special If you have both transfer wounds and sickening touch, choose which ability this feat affects when you take this feat. You may take this feat multiple times, once for each ability. You are able to channel mythic energy to transfer wounds more often.
benefit: you gain two additional daily uses of your transfer wounds or sickening touch ability. additionally, if you have no uses of transfer wounds or sickening touch remaining, you may expend one use of mythic power to use your transfer wounds or sickening touch ability

name: Fade from Memory
description: You can vanish from the immediate memory of those around you.
benefit: when you use stealth to hide, you can expend your psionic focus to cause creatures within close range (25 feet + 5 feet per two character levels) to forget about you until you reappear. only creatures who failed to see through your initial stealth check are affected, and an affected creature can make a will save (dc 10 + 1/2 your character level + your highest mental ability score modifier) to resist this effect. when you expend your psionic focus in order to hide at the end of your movement using the divert perception feat, you can also use this one as part of the same action, without having to expend psionic focus a second time.

name: Fast Aid
description: Requests to you for healing can be made much faster. Normal Request aid costs a standard action to perform.
prerequisites: heal 7 ranks, spellcraft 7 ranks, request aid class feature.
benefit: your allies may choose to request aid as a swift action.

name: Fast Step
description: You are able to teleport more easily. You can rapidly alter your location.
benefit: you can use the nomads step class feature as a swift action. alternatively, you can spend one use of mythic power to use nomads step as an immediate action. in addition, you add your mythic tier to your psion class level when determining the distance you can travel while using nomads step.

name: Faster and Faster
description: You are truly dedicated to the concept of speed.
benefit: each time you gain a 10 feet insight bonus to speed from the accelerate class feature (including the initial 10 feet from the speed of thought feat), you instead gain 15 feet of additional speed.

name: Favored Energy
description: You prefer a certain energy type over all others. Powers using your favored energy are particularly damaging.
benefit: when manifesting a power that deals damage of your favored energy type, the powers damage is increased by an additional 50% (round down.) this stacks with the effects of empower power to increase the damage by 100%.

name: Fear Mastery
