benefit: if a thrown attack of yours would strike a flat and sturdy surface, such as a wall, you may expend your psionic focus to psychoportatively redirect its momentum up to 90 degrees, allowing it to continue as if it were thrown in that new direction. each time you redirect your attack in this manner, your attack roll suffers a -2 penalty on the attack and damage roll.

name: Sadism
description: The pain of your collective reinvigorates you.
benefit: whenever another member of your collective takes damage, you may expend your psionic focus as an immediate action in order to gain temporary hit points equal to half the damage dealt. these temporary hit points fade at a rate of 1 per round, and stack with temporary hit points gained from this feat. you may only gain temporary hit points in this way to a limit of up to half of your normal maximum hit points.

name: Shattered Dream Strike
description: You sap your opponents will with your attacks.
prerequisites: devastating touch class feature, improved unarmed strike, broken dreams style, intimidate 6 ranks
benefit: while in the broken dreams style, after making a successful unarmed strike empowered with your devastating touch, you can make a free intimidate check against the target.

name: Sigilist
description: Your manifesting includes glowing sigils.
prerequisites: the ability to manifest a power
benefit: unlike most manifesters, you must draw glowing sigils either on the ground, in the air, or on your body to manifest a power, adding a somatic component to your manifesting. however, these sigils bind your powers to this world and make them hard to resist, giving you a +1 bonus to save dcs and +2 to your manifester level to overcome power resistance.

name: Soulbound Implements
description: You form your mind blade with a touch of psychic power, warping its function to match your implement's. Normal If your mind blade is reduced to a +0 enhancement bonus, you must reshape it to have a valid combination of enhancement bonus and weapon special abilities.
prerequisites: enhanced mind blade class feature, occultist level 1st.
benefit: your occultist levels and your soulknife levels stack to determine the enhancement bonus granted by your enhanced mind blade class feature and the maximum enhancement bonus of your mind blade. in addition, you can channel your mind blade with the power of one of the implement on your person, reducing its enhancement bonus by +1 to tie it to that implements school. once per round, when you hit an opponent with your mind blade, you can activate one of that implements focus powers that is normally used as a standard action as a free action, paying 1 extra point of mental focus to do so. if the focus power is an effect that targets an opponent, it must target the opponent you hit. your mind blade can be reduced to a +0 enhancement bonus by this feat without needing to reshape it, and you can return it to its normal enhancement bonus (breaking its link with the implement) as a free action.

name: Speed of Thought
description: The energy of your mind energizes the alacrity of your body. You are faster than the eye can see.
benefit: double the bonus to your speed from speed of thought. in addition, you can expend a use of mythic power when taking a 5-foot step to instead move your full speed.

name: Spirited Psicrystal
description: Even after you die and return from death, your psicrystal remains bonded to you. In addition, having this extra bond strengthens you against further peril. While your psicrystal is active, you gain a +2 bonus on saves against death effects and on checks made to stabilize while you are dying. Normal When you die, your psicrystal is destroyed. When your psicrystal is destroyed, it reforms after 24 hours.
benefit: whenever you die and are returned to life, your psicrystal automatically reforms immediately. when it reforms, it must have the same personality as the original.

name: Spirit Feast
description: You have become far more efficient in your efforts to preserve your life. The limit to the amount that you may heal through one use of Feast of Folly increases to twice your HD.
benefit: when you use the feast of folly feat, you heal 2 hit points for each point of ability burn taken instead of 1. if you expend your psionic focus, you heal 3 per point of ability burn instead.

name: Split-Headed Lash
description: The pyrokineticist has learned to split her focus and attack multiple targets at once.
prerequisites: fire lash class feature, knowledge (psionics) 10 ranks, point blank shot, precise shot, weapon focus (whip)
benefit: by expending your psionic focus as part of a full attack, you can split you fire lash into two separate heads for the first attack. the fire lash returns to normal for the remaining attacks. each heads attack is rolled separately and need not be at the same target. if attacking multiple targets, these targets must be within 10 ft. of each other and both must be within 15 ft. of the pyrokineticist. any extra damage dice that would have applied to the fire lash attack are applied to both heads, including damage from sources such as sneak attack and psychic strike.

name: Staggering Shot
description: Your ranged and thrown attacks stagger fearful opponents.
prerequisites: intimidating shot, point-blank shot, base attack bonus +6.
benefit: as long as you maintain psionic focus, as a standard action, you may make a single ranged or thrown attack against an enemy that is frightened, panicked, or shaken. if the attack hits, you deal damage normally and the target is staggered until the end of your next turn unless it makes a fortitude saving throw (dc 10 + 1/2 your character level + your wis modifier). this feat has no effect on targets that are staggered.

name: Strike the Heart River
description: You have learned how to couple your psionic power with your trained insight into striking a telling blow against an unprepared enemy, allowing you to siphon their strength away.
prerequisites: psicrystal affinity, psionic weapon, cortex strike, superior psicrystal (psicrystal weapon variant), sneak attack +3d6.
benefit: when you expend your psionic focus for the purpose of your psionic weapon feat with a psicrystal weapon, you can choose to not deal any damage and for every 1d6 points of sneak attack damage you could do, the enemy takes 1 point of strength damage instead. this can be used even on creatures immune to sneak attacks.

name: Superior Psicrystal
description: You have improved your psicrystal in one of many ways, manifesting a better creature.
benefit: this feat grants you a choice of special psicrystal from those described in the alternate psicrystals section of the psicrystals page.

name: Surge Blade
description: You can enhance your mind blade with your wild surge.
prerequisites: mind blade class feature, wild surge class feature.
benefit: you may invoke your wild surge as a swift action to increase your mind blades damage by one die step, as well as gain an insight bonus equal to your wild surges intensity on attack and damage rolls made with your mind blade. these persist until the beginning of your next turn.

name: Surging Aura
description: Your wild surge enhances the aim of nearby allies. Your wild surges inspire your allies in battle.
benefit: the insight bonus from your surging aura doubles and the effect lasts a number of rounds equal to your mythic tier.

name: Swift Imbuement
description: You have learned how to efficiently charge your mind blades psychic strike to make it more available in combat. Normal You charge your psychic strike as a move action.
prerequisites: ability to generate a mind blade, psychic strike +1d8.
benefit: you may charge your psychic strike as a swift action.

name: Swift Shapeshifter
description: You are naturally confident with different shapes and forms, and years of training have allowed your body to more easily flow into new shapes.
benefit: when you manifest minor metamorphosis, major metamorphosis or metamorphosis the manifestation time is a move action instead of a standard action.

name: Symbiotic Power
description: Your collective allows you to gain a brief surge of psionic power.
benefit: up to 3 times per day, as a swift action, you gain a +1 bonus to your manifester level for every member of your collective that has a caster or manifester level. this increase does not allow you to augment powers beyond your regular manifester level, but affects your ability to add metapsionics to them and all other aspects of manifested power.

name: Symbiotic Speed
description: Your collective allows you to gain a brief burst of speed.
benefit: up to 3 times per day, as a swift action, you gain a +5 feet bonus per member to your movement speed until the end of your current turn.

name: Symbiotic Strength
description: Your collective allows you to gain a brief burst of strength.
benefit: up to 3 times per day, as a swift action, you gain a +1 bonus per member to your next strength check or your next melee attack and damage roll.

name: Talented
description: You can overchannel powers with less cost to yourself. You are incredibly skilled at pushing yourself beyond normal limits.
benefit: add half your tier (minimum 1) to the maximum power level you can use talented on to not take damage from when overchanneling.

name: Telekinetic Push
description: Your telekinetic ability includes the ability to knock enemies down.
benefit: up to three times per day, you can focus your telekinetic powers into a single blow or ranged attack as a swift action, which can knock a foe over. when you do so, make a trip check, substituting your highest mental ability modifier for your strength (if it is higher) and using your hit die instead of your base attack bonus.

name: Telekinetic Retrieval
description: You are able to use your telekinetic ability to bring things back to your hand after you throw them.
benefit: when throwing a thrown weapon, you can use your far hand psi-like ability as a swift action to recall your thrown weapon in the same round as you threw it, provided the weight of the thrown weapon is within your weight limits for the ability

name: Telekinetic Strength
description: When subjected to combat maneuvers, your telekinetic abilities augment your physical strength.
benefit: you can use your telekinesis to bolster yourself against certain combat maneuvers, giving you a +2 bonus to cmd against bull rush, trip, reposition and pull combat maneuvers. in addition, you gain a +2 bonus to cmb when attempting to break out of a grapple.

name: Telepathic Feedback
description: You overload the connections people make with your minds.
benefit: you may activate this feat whenever you are targeted by a hostile mind-affecting ability, power, or spell, or when you are subjected to unwanted telepathic contact (you are automatically aware of when you have been targeted or contacted in this manner, though without further information you might not be able to identify the source). the source of the ability or contact must succeed at a will save (dc 10 + 1/2 your character level + your wisdom or charisma modifier) or suffer damage equal to your character level. you may only activate this feat once per provoking ability or contact.

name: Telepathic Link
description: Your experience with joining minds has progressed to the point that you are now able to maintain a permanent telepathic connection with others. As a standard action, you may add any number of creatures in line of sight to this link; however the link may never contain more creatures than your key ability modifier (minimum 1). You are always a member of the link and do not count against this limit. You may remove any number of creatures from the link as a free action, and any creature within the link may remove itself as a free action. Any creature in the link which moves beyond medium range (100 ft. + 10 ft./manifester level) from you or falls unconscious or dies is automatically removed from the link. Special You may take this feat multiple times. Each additional time, the maximum number of creatures in the link is increased by 2.
prerequisites: manifester level 3rd, ability to manifest mindlink.
benefit: as long as you maintain psionic focus, you may maintain a telepathic connection between yourself and other willing creatures. creatures so connected may communicate with you and each other telepathically, even if they do not share a common language.

name: Terror Mastery
description: You have learned to activate multiple terrors at a time. Normal You can only activate one terror at a time.
benefit: when you use your terrors class feature, you can activate two terrors in a single swift action.

name: Terror of the Hunt
description: When you howl, the terror seeps into foes far and wide. Special If you have a collective, you may choose for specific members of your collective to not be affected by this feat.
prerequisites: pack howl, hunting pack class feature.
benefit: when you use your pack howl feat, all creatures within one mile of you and your beasts who are not within the range of the pack howl itself must succeed at a will save (dc 10 + 1/2 your character level + your charisma modifier) or become shaken for one minute. this feat cannot create a stronger fear effect than shaken. a creature gains a +1 bonus on their save for every 500 feet between them and the nearest source of your pack howl.

name: Touch of Terror
description: Your devastating touch deals additional damage. Normal Devastating touch deals 1d6 points of damage plus your class level.
benefit: your devastating touch ability deals 1d6 points of damage plus your class level and your charisma modifier.

name: Toughened Suit
description: When you call your astral suit, you strengthen it with a boost of energy.
benefit: any time you form your astral suit, you can choose to pay 1 power point as part of the action to form the astral suit to gain 1 temporary hit point per aegis level you possess. these temporary hit points last until your astral suit is dismissed, destroyed, or otherwise ends.

name: Unavoidable Strike
description: You can make an unarmed strike or use a natural weapon against your foe as if delivering a touch attack. You must decide whether or not to use this feat prior to making an attack. If your attack misses, you still expend your psionic focus. Abilities that do not work on touch attacks similarly do not work with this feat. Your mythic power guides your unarmed strikes and natural attacks.
benefit: when you make an attack using unavoidable strike, add half your tier (minimum 1) to the attack roll. in addition, you can expend a use of mythic power when using unavoidable strike to treat all attacks made during your turn as melee touch attacks

name: Uncarnate Psicrystal
description: You are shedding your physical form and your psicrystal, sharing an unbreakable bond of mind and soul is walking the same path as you. It has learned to shed its physical form as you have learned to shed your body and one day it will become uncarnate just as you. Special If you have the Uncarnate class ability, your psicrystal also gains this ability and receives a deflection bonus to AC equal to his former natural armor, which it looses while incorporeal. If you are permanently incorporeal, so does your psicrystal become and can use Shed Body to instead become corporeal.
prerequisites: psicrystal affinity, shed body class ability.
benefit: your psicrystal gains the shed body class ability, usable as often as your ability is.

name: Unhindered Way
description: You psionically augment your mobility in armor.
prerequisites: speed of thought, proficiency with medium armor.
benefit: your speed is not reduced by medium and heavy armor, and you can gain the of your speed of thought feat while wearing heavy armor.

name: Unwilling Participant
description: You are able to force others into your collective. If you expend your psionic focus while using this feat, the action required to attempt to force a living creature into your collective is instead a move action. Normal Only willing creatures may be added to a collective. Creatures may leave the collective as a free action. Special Creatures forced into your collective using Unwilling Participant are considered willing members for any collective-related effects unless they succeed on another Will save at the same DC to resist being forced into the collective. A successful save means the creature resisted the specific effect but is still a member of the collective. Creatures find it difficult to resist joining your collective.
benefit: you add half your tier to the save dc when forcing an unwilling creature into your collective. additionally, you can expend one use of mythic power when a creature succeeds on its saving throw against being added to your collective to force that creature to roll a second time and take the lower result.

name: Up the Walls
description: You can run on walls for brief distances. Special You can take other move actions in conjunction with moving along a wall. For instance, the Spring Attack feat allows you to make an attack from the wall against a foe standing on the ground who is within the area you threaten; however, if you are somehow prevented from completing your move, you fall. Likewise, you could tumble along the wall to avoid attacks of opportunity. Your ability to traverse walls defies all laws of physics.
benefit: you can expend a use of mythic power when using the up the walls feat to remain on a surface other than the floor for a number of rounds equal to your tier.

name: Vent Agony
description: You share your psychic pain with others.
benefit: whenever you suffer psychic enervation or use your overchannel feat, you may select a hostile creature within 30 feet that creature must succeed at a will save (dc 10 + 1/2 your manifester level + your key ability modifier) or suffer the effects of your psychic enervation and/or the damage from your overchannel feat (you still suffer those effects yourself). this is a pain effect.

name: Vigilant Avatar
description: Your avatar is incredibly perceptive, and its connection with you improves your own observational skills.
benefit: while your avatar is within reach, you gain a +4 bonus on perception checks. if you have 10 or more ranks in perception, this bonus increases to +8. this doesnt apply if your avatar is helpless or unconscious.

name: Wild Mind
description: Its hard to get a grip on your mind.
benefit: while ing from your surging euphoria, you also gain a bonus equal to your wild surges intensity on saving throws against mind-affecting abilities, powers, and spells. you may expend your psionic focus as an immediate action to double the bonus granted by this feat for 1 round.

name: Words of Salvation
description: Your false judgments bring real hope and the promise of a better future. Special You may not use both Condemning Glare and Words of Salvation on the same target within a 24-hour period.
benefit: when you succeed on a check to use the divine judgment feat, you may also attempt to use diplomacy to change the attitude of the target (including the bonus from divine judgment) as a free action. once per day, while the target is at least indifferent towards you, you may manifest naijas compelling voice on that target as a psi-like ability, with a dc equal to 12 + your charisma modifier and a manifester level equal to your hd, ignoring normal immunities to mind-affecting effects.

name: Wounding Attack
description: Your vicious attacks wound your foe. You must decide whether or not to use this feat prior to making an attack. If your attack misses, you still expend your psionic focus. Your attacks are particularly debilitating.
benefit: the constitution damage dealt from wounding attack is doubled. in addition, you can expend a use of mythic power as a swift action when an attack made with wounding attack misses to reroll the attack roll.

name: Zealous Blade
description: Your conviction fuels the power of the weapon you have idealized for your cause.
prerequisites: enhanced mind blade class feature, zeal class feature.
benefit: you add your zealot level to your soulknife level to determine the enhancement bonus granted by your enhanced mind blade class feature, the maximum enhancement bonus of your mind blade, the effects of your blade skills, and which blade skills you can select.

name: Abomination Shift
description: Special At 3 Shifting feats, your chance to ignore sneak attacks and critical hits increases to 10% per Shifting feat. When making a 2 round shift, you gain a bonus equal to the number of Shifting feats you possess on saves against mind-affecting abilities. At 5 Shifting feats, you gain All Around Vision. When making a 2-round shift, you gain a bonus equal to the number of Shifting feats you possess on saving throws against disease, poison, and effects that cause either exhaustion or fatigue.
benefit: you gain a 5% chance per shifting feat to ignore sneak attacks and critical hits. this shift lasts for 10 minutes. however, if you reduce the duration to 2 rounds, you also gain a +1 bonus to cmb and cmd for each shifting feat you possess.

name: Beasthide Shift
description: Special At 3 Shifting feats, half of your Natural Armor bonus applies to your Touch AC (rounded down). At 5 Shifting feats, you add your full Natural Armor bonus to your Touch AC
benefit: you gain a +1 bonus to natural armor for each [shifting] feat you possess. this shift lasts for 2 rounds.

name: Chameleon Shift
description: Special At 3 Shifting feats, you no longer take a -5 penalty for attempting to move more than half your normal speed while hiding. At 5 Shifting feats, you may attempt a Stealth check to hide even when observed.
benefit: you gain a +1 bonus on stealth checks for each shifting feat you possess. this shift lasts for 1 hour.

name: Deathsting Shift
description: Special At 3 Shifting feats, your tail grows more powerful, functioning as a third arm in many ways. You can use your tail to grab unattended items within 5 feet as a swift action as well as to grab stowed objects carried on your person; you can hold such objects with your tail, though you cannot manipulate or wield them with your tail (other than to put them in your hand). When making a 2 round shift, you may use your sting attack against enemies 5 feet further away. You may still use it to attack adjacent enemies. Additionally, your poison now deals 2d2 Str damage per round. At 5 Shifting feats, your tail acts as third hand that you can use for anything a normal hand could be used for. This does not give you any extra attacks or actions per round, though it can wield weapons and make attacks as part of your attack routines just like a normal hand (you merely cannot attack with a third weapon). The hand can manipulate or hold items just as well as your normal hands (for example, allowing you to use one hand to wield a weapon, another hand to hold a potion, and the third hand to hold a shield). When making a 2 round shift, when you hit an opponent with your sting, you may attempt a reposition combat maneuver as a free action without provoking an attack of opportunity, but you must reposition the target closer to you than where they were when you started the reposition maneuver. Additionally, your poison now deals 3d2 Str damage.
benefit: you grow a tail , aiding in your balance. you gain a +2 bonus on acrobatics checks for each shifting feat you possess. this shift lasts for 1 hour. however, if you reduce the duration to 2 rounds you gain a sting attack, which functions as a primary natural attack dealing 1d4 damage for a medium creature. the stinger contains a poison that deals 1d2 points of strength damage once per round for 6 rounds. the fortitude save dc is 10 + 1/2 your character level + your constitution modifier +1 per shifting feat you possess. this shift lasts for 2 rounds.

name: Extra Shifting
benefit: special you do not need to have a shift active to from this feat.

name: Identity Shift
description: Special At 3 Shifting feats, you are able to take on muscle memory of the target. When disguising yourself as a specific person, observers do not get an automatic check or a bonus to identify you based on familiarity. At 5 Shifting feats, you can take on whole new identities, to the point of becoming an entirely different person. When you shift, you may choose to adopt your second identity, which is consistent regardless of the specific form taken. Knowledge checks about the second identity do not reveal information about the original identity. Any attempts to scry or otherwise locate the character work only if the character is currently in the identity the creature is attempting to locate. Otherwise, the spell or effect has no effect, revealing nothing but darkness, as if the target were invalid or did not exist.
benefit: you gain a +2 bonus on disguise checks for each shifting feat you possess, and can make a disguise check as part of your shift. this shift lasts for 1 hour

name: Longstride Shift
description: Special At 3 Shifting feats, you may ignore difficult terrain when moving or charging. At 5 Shifting feats, you may move up to your movement speed once per encounter as a swift action.
benefit: you gain a +5ft bonus to your base land speed for each shifting feat you possess. this shift lasts for 1 hour.

name: Magnitude Shift
description: Special At 4 Shifting feats, you may shrink 2 size categories.This shift lasts for 1 hour and does not affect your ability scores. At 5 Shifting feats, you may grow 2 size categories. This shift lasts for 2 rounds and does not affect your ability scores.
benefit: you shrink 1 size category, as per reduce person, except that it affects you regardless of your creature type and does not affect your ability scores. this shift lasts for 10 minutes. however, if you reduce the shift duration to 1 minute, you may instead grow 1 size category, as per enlarge person, except that it affects you regardless of your creature type and does not affect your ability scores. both size changes do not stack with other size changing effects.

name: Rapid Shifting
description: Special At 3 Shifting feats, you may shift as an immediate action. At 5 Shifting feats, you can shift as a free action, even when it isnt your turn. You may still not shift if you are flat-footed. This feat modifies the actions required to shift, and is active even when you are not shifted.
benefit: you may always shift as a free action on your turn.

name: Sensory Shift
description: In melee, every time you miss because of concealment, you can reroll your miss chance percentile roll one time to see if you actually hit. An invisible attacker gets no advantages related to hitting you in melee. That is, you dont lose your Dexterity bonus to Armor Class, and the attacker doesnt get the usual +2 bonus for being invisible. The invisible attackers bonuses do still apply for ranged attacks, however. You take only half the usual penalty to speed for being unable to see. Darkness and poor visibility in general reduces your speed to three-quarters normal, instead of one-half. Special At 3 Shifting feats, you gain scent. When making a one minute shift, you gain blindsense out to 5ft per Shifting feat you possess At 5 Shifting feats, you only take half the normal penalty to Perception checks from distance. When making a one minute shift, you gain uncanny dodge.
benefit: you gain a +1 bonus on perception checks for each shifting feat you possess. this shift lasts for 1 hour. however, if you reduce the duration to one minute, you also gain the following .

name: Strongclaw Shift
description: Special At 3 Shifting feats, you gain a climb speed equal to your base land speed. When making a 2 round shift, your claws overcome all magic or material based DR or Regeneration. At 5 Shifting feats, you gain a burrow speed equal to your base land speed. When making a 2 round shift, You gain the rend special ability with your claws. Once per round, when you hit a creature with two of your claws, you deal additional damage as if you had hit again with one of your claws, plus 1-1/2 your Strength bonus (if any).
benefit: you gain a +2 bonus on climb checks for each shifting feat you possess. this shift lasts for 1 hour. however, if you reduce the shift duration to 2 rounds, you also gain two claw attacks, which function as primary natural weapons dealing 1d4 damage each for medium creatures, +1 damage for every 2 shifting feats you possess.

name: Swiftwing Shift
description: Special At 3 Shifting feats, your wings become strong enough to carry your weight and you gain a fly speed equal to half of your base land speed (rounded down) with poor maneuverability At 5 Shifting feats, your wings become even stronger and you gain a fly speed equal to your base land speed with Average maneuverability.
benefit: you grow a pair of small vestigial wings that grant a +2 bonus on fly checks for each shifting feat you possess. this shift lasts for 1 hour.

name: Wavelord Shift
description: Special At 3 Shifting feats, you gain a swim speed equal to your base land speed, and you can hold your breath underwater for 10 times as long as normal. Additionally, your bite overcomes all Magic or material based DR or Regeneration At 5 Shifting feats, you gain the aquatic and amphibious subtypes while using this shift. When making a 2 round shift, you gain the Trip ability with your bite attack. If you already possessed the Trip ability, you gain an additional +2 bonus to your trip attempts.
benefit: you gain a +2 bonus on swim checks for each shifting feat you possess. this shift lasts for 1 hour. however, if you reduce the shift duration to 2 rounds, you also gain a bite attack, which functions as a primary natural weapon dealing 1d6 damage for a medium creature.

name: Shattered Dream Strike
description: You sap your opponents will with your attacks.
prerequisites: devastating touch class feature, improved unarmed strike, broken dreams style, intimidate 6 ranks
benefit: while in the broken dreams style, after making a successful unarmed strike empowered with your devastating touch, you can make a free intimidate check against the target.

name: Deadly Pairing
description: Through working together, you and an ally are capable of striking vital locations.
prerequisites: deadly strike +1d6, at least one steel serpent stance known.
benefit: whenever you and another ally flank a creature both you and that ally increase the critical threat range of your weapons by 1 (so a weapon with a 19-20 threat range would increase to 18-20) if you or your ally are in a stance from the steel serpent discipline. this additional critical threat range is not multiplied by abilities such as keen or the improved critical feat and is applied after abilities such as those are applied.

name: Fly in Formation
description: You are skilled at flying together with your companions.
benefit: you gain a +2 bonus on fly checks and you improve the maneuverability of your fly speed by one step while adjacent to a flying ally with this feat. if an adjacent ally with this feat would fall, and you have a free hand or other grasping appendage, you can catch them as an immediate action. if you are flying with a heavy load, or your allys additional weight would put you at a heavy load, you both begin to fall slowly towards the ground at a rate of 60 feet per round and take no damage upon landing.

name: Share the Load
description: You can share the weight of heavy burdens with your allies almost as if you were yoked together.
benefit: when you are adjacent to one or more allies who also have this feat, you treat strength score as 1 higher than normal when determining your carrying capacity, for each such ally (maximum +4). additionally, when adjacent to an ally that also has this feat, you are treated as one size category larger for the purposes of deciding the maximum size of creatures you can target with the drag and reposition combat maneuvers. this effective size increase does not stack with itself, but it does stack with all other size changes or effective size changes. the of this feat are supernatural in nature.

name: Shared Identity
benefit: you and another creature with this feat can choose to share each others social and vigilante identities. this allows you to impersonate and use that creatures social and vigilante identities as if they were your own, as well as allowing them access to yours as if it were their own.

name: Defensive Strike
description: You can turn a strong defense into a powerful offense.
benefit: If an opponent attacks you and misses while you are using the total defense action, you can attack that opponent with a +4 bonus on your attack roll. You gain no bonus against an opponent that does not attack you or against an opponent that attacks and hits you. A character that gets multiple attacks in a round applies the +4 bonus only to her first attack for the round.
special: A fighter may select Defensive Strike as one of his fighter bonus feats.

name: Track Star
description: Your godlike dexterity enhances your natural speeds significantly.
prerequisites: Dex 20, +2 per tier to gain access to subsequent abilities
benefit: The bonus granted by this feat is based on hit dice. 1 HD: You gain the feat Run 5 HDs: For every 5 HDs you have, you gain 10ft on your land speed. 10 HDs: You gain the ability to move up walls and other surfaces provided you end your movement on a horizontal surface which can support you. You also take no penalty on uneven terrain. 15 HDs: You may now Run in any armor type at full speed.

name: Comeback
description: When all seems lost you always get back up.
benefit: Gain +5 on critical damage saves. You recover Hitdie+Con Mod+Mythic Rank in hp after critical damage without sacrificing your turn. When reduced to 0 for the first time in a combat, recover your Hitdie+Con Mod+Mythic Rank in HP after one turn (This can stack with the recovery from critical damage but only if you take two full turns for the effect).

name: Improved Comeback
description: You refuse to stay down (T)
benefit: Gain an additional +10 on critical damage saves. You can use Comeback once per fight on any attack, not just for critical recovery.

name: Greater Diehard
description: You refuse to die. (T)
benefit: Add the negative value of your total HD to the HP value at which you die. For example, a 9th level character would not die at -10 hp, but they'd die at -19 hp. Also, add the negative value of all hit points granted by Toughness and Improved Toughness to this amount (if you have those feats).

name: Incredible Resilience
description: It's very hard to kill you.
benefit: Whenever you fail a saving throw against a death effect or coup de grace attempt, you do not automatically die. Instead, you merely lose an amount of hit points equal to 10% of your normal maximum and you are stunned for 1 round (although this might still kill you). This HP loss is in addition to any damage dealt by the actual effect. Also, whenever you make a Fortitude save or Concentration check against an effect that uses damage to determine the DC (such as a coup de grace which is DC=damage dealt) you cut the damage in half for the purposes of determining the DC (round down).
normal: When you fail a saving throw against a death effect or coup de grace (DC10+damage dealt), you instantly die.

name: Endurance (FIAT)
description: You perform well even on death's door.
benefit: You reduce the penalty from being grazed, wounded, or critical by 1 (to –0, –1, and –2, respectively).

name: Fragile Strength
description: Your strength fades as you take on damage. Cannot take this with Endurance
benefit: You increase the penalty from being wounded or critical (no increase on grazed) Grazed -1, Wounded -3, Critical -6. In exchange you are granted a +3 all attack rolls, saving throws, skill checks, and ability checks, as well as to AC and caster level when above the wounded tier.

name: Great Ability Score
description: The opportunity for power can be attained, at the price of skill.
benefit: Adds 1 to any ability score, can be taken infinite times.

name: Perfect Called shot
description: Precision is an art and you have mastered it.
benefit: You can make as many called shots as you can on any attack with no penalty.

name: Heroic Brawn
description: A paragon among your kind, your size does not restrict your feats of strength.
benefit: You count as one size larger weapons wielded and gain a +8 Carry Strength.

name: Legendary Brawn (Mythic)
description: Unrivaled among your kind, you possess the strength to move any obstacle in your path with ease. Muscles forged in the fires of hell meant to bear the weight of the world itself.
benefit: you count as an additional size category larger for weapons wielded and may apply the size bonus from Heroic Brawn and Legendary Brawn to both CMB and CMD. Additionally you gain another +8 to Carry Strength Additionally, you may as a free action for a mythic power point, Ignore an additional 2 size increment penalties for maneuvering a target for a single check.

name: Might Makes Right
description: Your great strength draws more followers to your side.
benefit: Add your Strength bonus to your leadership score for the purposes of determining how many followers you may have with the Leadership feat.

name: Sniper Shot (3.5e)
description: You are incredibly precise within your weapons natural range.
benefit: Whenever you make a ranged attack within the first range increment, it is considered to be within 30 feet.

name: Overbear
description: Warriors who opt to master the art of defense prior to mastering offense, have a 26% higher survival rate.
benefit: You gain a +1 shield bonus when you wield a two-handed or double weapon. This bonus increases to +2 when fighting defensively or using total defense. You also gain a +4 bonus to CMD checks made to resist being moved, bull rushed or overran when wielding such a weapon.
special: A fighter may select Overbear as one of his fighter bonus feats. A ruffian may choose Overbear as one of his Ruffian brawling maneuvers.

name: Unified Power
description: The source from which your abilities draw is one in the same. Through mastery of the energies that drive you, you have attained the power to siphon your abilities through a single catalyst.
prerequisites: Endurance OR 20 in a stat that one of your resource pools scales off of.
benefit: Spell pool, Ki, Stamina, Power Points, Grit, channel, Rage, Spell Points, Mana, bardic performance, or Lay on Hands. If you have access to multiple of these pools you may combine them into one using a maximum of three sources. Your primary source gets its full normal pool, your secondary source only confers its flat resource pool, and your tertiary source only gives you its scaling resource pool. Any ability that restores points to any of your pools normally also restores a point to this communal pool; however any ability that inhibits, blocks or drains your resources also does so to your communal pool. When restored it restores based on its original pool stats. *Does not apply to Strain Based Mana Casters

name: Singular Locus
description: You have fully dedicated yourself to complete mastery of a single thing. Your dedication allows you to go farther than any other.
prerequisites: Endurance OR 20 in a stat that one of your resource pools scales off of
benefit: Spell pool, Ki, Stamina, Power Points, Grit, channel, ki, Rage, Spell Points, Mana, bardic performance, or Lay on Hands. Provided you only have one of the above you may increase your daily amount of uses by 1/4 of the normal amount you would receive, unaugmented by traits and feats. (If your resource is Spell Points or Mana you may not have any other means of casting aside from spell like abilities Additionally, you may sacrifice 10 non lethal hitpoints that may not be negated or reduced by anything or healed except through natural means to gain 1 point of your chosen resource. Any ability that would reduce, expel, or negate your resource must first succeed on a CMB or MSB or Caster Level check first to do so. This check is equal to your CR+Highest Ability Modifier+Mythic Rank. If an ability would reduce or inhibit use of your resource by default with no check it is subject to one albeit at a +5 bonus.

name: Efficient Output
description: The weave is limited to one's output. The easiest way to increase one's output is to reduce the waste produced during energy conversion.
benefit: Reduce Strain Cost by 1 for one spell level. *Can be taken multiple times but only once per spell level. *If you naturally reduce the strain cost for a spell level to 0 you can bump up your chosen level by 1 for this feat.

name: Life Energy
description: Your abundant life source refuels your magical energies.
benefit: Use Con instead of your casting modifier to calculate Strain Recovery.

name: Improved Strain Recovery
description: Efficient energy production and refined conversion output are one thing, but a faster recovery lends itself well to those who see regular action.
benefit: Strain Recovery occurs once every 30 minutes rather than hour.

name: Greater Strain Recovery
description: You have pushed the limits to natural mana production to newer heights.
benefit: Strain Recovery occurs whenever you would lose a single point of strain rounding up by round. *Divide 30 by your strain recovery to find a by the minute calculation. If Jazar has a 12 strain recovery, he would lose 1 strain every 2.5 minutes, or 25 rounds.

name: Fount of Will
description: Through sheer willpower and knowledge you can push yourself beyond your own magical limitations.
benefit: Instead of making Fortitude saves when exceeding your strain tolerance, you may make Will Saves.

name: Overcharged
description: You house a secondary vessel that can properly catch energy that would have been otherwise wasted due to overflow.
benefit: When Stealing/Being Charged with additional mana/spell levels you can hold an amount equal to half your strain in a secondary vessel. You can use this additional mana to forcefully increase a spells caster level, or just to cast additional spells. This vessel does not naturally regenerate like your primary one does.

name: Awakened Power
description: Greatness can hide in the most unlikely of places.
benefit: Gain use of 1st level bloodline or domain ability. Can be taken again for each tier of bloodline ability in any order you choose. Your level for the purposes of the abilities is your Character Level. The stat they scale off is the higher of your Charisma, Wisdom, or Intelligence.

name: Charge-less Bloodline/Domain
description: Your natural talents are hardly fleeting
benefit: unlimited use of level 1 bloodline and domain ability of your choice

name: Empowered
description: You continue to build on your speciality rather than simply trivialize it with new abilities.
benefit: add one damage dice to one of your level 1 abilities; or a +2 to its DC.

name: Extra Power Use
description: You gain a deeper reservoir from which your natural ability may draw.
benefit: double use of ability beyond level 1 of your choice. Stacks multiplicatively. Take twice for infinite use for 2nd-6th level powers, three times for 7th-12th, four for 13th-19th, and five for 20th.

name: Empowered Greater
description: You can focus more energy into your abilities than previously possible. (T1)
prerequisites: Access to Level 1 bloodline or domain ability
benefit: add one damage dice to any of your bloodline/domain abilities or a +2 to its DC. Can be taken once per level for damage dice or once every 5 levels for DC

name: Casting from Within
description: Your bloodline has bestowed you with the innate ability to shape the world to your will.
benefit: Gain use of all bloodline/domain spells available to a caster level equivalent to your hit dice. You gain a daily pool of spell points equal to ¼ of your hit dice. You spend one spell point per the spells level when casting. Casting this way cannot be augmented by metamagic feats, and you cannot increase your casting time under any circumstances.

name: Improved Casting from Within
description: You are nearly indistinguishable to a real caster
benefit: Your daily pool of spell points increases to ½ of your hit dice.

name: Perfected Casting from Within
description: Wizards spend their entire lives attempting to harness the power you were naturally given.
benefit: Your daily pool of spell points increases to a total equal to your hit dice.

name: Crush
description: Loxophants are a docile race who actively avoid conflict, but despite their passive nature, they are renowned for their destructive power.
benefit: You gain a d10 Trample natural attack against smaller creatures in any square you occupy, this can be augmented by any feat that changes natural attacks. Only works on creatures smaller than you.

name: Trunk Training
description: Due to their size and naturally stiff limbs, many Loxophants, especially Artisans, meticulously train their trunks as a third hand.
benefit: You gain a d8 bludgeoning strike with your trunk. This can be augmented by any feat that changes natural attacks. Due to your trunk being extensively trained, when making a full attack action using the trunk as an off hand weapon or natural attack, you only incur a -2 penalty to the attack as opposed to a -5.

name: Loxo Neutrality
description: Loxolund has never engaged in a war that was not defensive, they do not publicly support or act in any external conflicts as a country.
benefit: You can make 2 rolls when making diplomacy or bluff checks to avoid conflicts, take the higher of the two; additionally add +2 to both diplomacy and bluff.

name: Adaptive Evolution
description: Kalyptrans over the years, as a natural effect of splitting into separate genetic tribes who consistently perform specialized duties, have developed significant differences than many of their kin. While on a base level the differing tribes remain Kalyptran, their specialized evolutions have yielded wildly differing genetic paths. In the rare instance when crossbreeding between the tribes occurs, unforeseen genetic mutations can develop down the line as both a consequence...and a benefit, depending on your perspective.
prerequisites: Kalyptran; Free Bonus Feat at level 1
benefit: You gain a flexible +4 racepoints. These points may be used to buy a trait that is worth a maximum of +4, but may buy as many lower cost abilities as they are able to.

name: Improved Adaptive Evolution
description: Kalyptrans, as a result of their dedication, often develop their natural born abilities further as they age. It is not usual however, for their non-dominant mutations to emerge later in life.
benefit: You gain an additional +4 racepoints. These points may be used to buy a trait that is worth a maximum of +4, but may buy as many lower cost abilities as they are able.

name: Perfect Evolution
description: The Kalyptran genome is a mysterious thing. Similar to the evolutionary development of early stage goblinoids. Kalyptrans have greatly adapted to their surroundings. Through selective breeding, they have isolated and developed a myriad of unique physical characteristics. A goblinoids development is driven by their perception of the world as well as their place in it; this is where differences begin to arise. Kalyptran DNA is sculpted over millennia to entirely new forms and proficiencies. However, paragon Kalyptrans have shown developments similar to the goblinoid kind. Typically speaking, a Kalyptran has two stages. Much akin to various different insects, they have a primary form in their younger life, and as they age and develop, eventually a complete secondary form. Recent evidence seems to point towards Kalyptrans who continually stress the limits of their naturally evolved gifts becoming capable of temporarily shifting the very structure of their DNA. Subjects both exhibit heightened passive abilities to their native counterparts as well the aforementioned genetic shuffling. However, this has universally proven to produce quite nasty health defects from the resulting genetic instability. -Darian Cosby
benefit: Choose 2 points of non magical eidolon evolutions and permanently apply them. You may at will utilize a Profession (Shapeshifter) check. Adapt a temporary physical trait. While doing so you are capped at a total of 4 non magic/supernatural evolution points. These traits last a number of rounds equal to the difference between the Shapeshifter DC and your check. While this is a free/immediate action you may only perform it once per round. Doing so causes you to take one point of unhealable constitution damage for 24 hours. The DC to shapeshift is equal to 15+(5*number of Eidolon points). If your Check is lower than the DC you fail and lose one point of constitution.
note: As for evolutions that give you an additional limb, if you have lost a limb the new one is permanent. You cannot take any magical or supernatural effects with this feat, this also applies to feats that are not purely physical.

name: Dolistani Martial Casting
description: Magic and Martial are one in the same.
benefit: Dolistani fighters are renowned for utilizing magic alongside their utilization of various martial traditions. You may cast and use bloodline/domain/school/Psychic Discipline abilities on attack actions.

name: Martial Sage
description: You are the pinnacle.
prerequisites: Dolistani, at least three style feats and a stance
benefit: Mastery of one's bloodline alongside a completed fighting style, A Dolistani Sage is a force to be reckoned with. You may cast and use bloodline/domain/school/Psychic Discipline abilities on attacks.

name: Ki Charge
description: Through focus and concentration, you can regain lost ki points.
prerequisites: 14 Wisdom (or stat that your ki is based on)
benefit: You may as a full round action (Total defense) until the start of your next turn, regain an amount of ki equal to 1/3 your level. When doing so convert all AC bonuses into deflect and add your ki stat to it and an additional +4 from total defense. If you take damage while doing so make a concentration check equal to the damage taken or regain no ki. Doing this action drains you physically and can only be done a number of times per day equal to your (Monk Level/4+Con Mod); if used more than once in one combat you are fatigued at the end of combat or when you run out of ki. Every additional use after the first increases your exhaustion level by an additional tier.

name: Ki Barrier
description: Your Ki is so powerful that you can use it to deflect incoming attacks. (T)
benefit: You may spend 1 ki as a free action to gain your Ki Mod to your deflection bonus for one minute. After using “Ki Charge”, retain the Ki Stat deflection bonus for one minute.

name: Improved Ki Barrier
description: You produce Ki in such abundance that it flows around your entire body. (T)
benefit: Ki barrier is always active as long as you retain a single ki point. You can spend 1 ki point as an immediate action to add 3 additional Deflection AC for one round.

name: Greater Ki Barrier
description: You have learned to focus your ki into a focused form. (T)
benefit: When Improved Ki barrier is active gain a bonus to DR/- equal to your ki mod.

name: Ultimate Ki Barrier
description: Through immense concentration and strenuous training you have reached the pinnacle defensive application of your ki. (T)
benefit: You may spend 2 instead 1 ki point when using improved Ki Barrier to increase the deflection bonus to 6.

name: Source of Ki
description: The source your power springs forth from..
prerequisites: Monk Level 10 (or a class that grants Ki)
benefit: You may change your Ki stat to strength or constitution (choose one) at will.

name: Violent Ki
description: Rather than to protect yourself, your ki is harnessed to destroy.
benefit: Violent Ki is always active as long as you retain a single ki point. You add an equal amount of damage to your natural attacks equal to your Ki Mod, if you have Ki barrier use its bonus instead. Violent Ki Damage is reduced by an opponent's Violent Ki or Ki Barrier Total whichever is higher. Upon receiving this feat you choose one damage type between Slashing, Bludgeoning, and Piercing. Your Violent Ki does this damage type permanently; this is somewhat important when fighting targets with different types of DR. You have some flexibility when describing aesthetically what is happening, and down the line may receive minor bonuses in the form of traits consistent with how you have themed.

name: Violent Ki Aura
description: Your destructive ki could perhaps cloak itself around your visage rather than simply protect...
benefit: Apply Violent Ki damage when struck.

name: Violent Ki Projection
description: You may attack from a range by projecting the force of your attacks with ki.
benefit: This acts as a ranged attack and all of the damage is converted into the same damage type as the base weapon damage dice. Ranged feats or Melee feats do apply (Not Both) as does anything that affects a flurry. Range increment 10 feet. You may apply Violent Ki or Violent Ki Weapon to damage.

name: Violent Ki Weapon
description: You can focus your ki into held weapons.
benefit: Violent Ki Weapon is always active as long as you retain a single ki point. You add an equal amount of damage to your manufactured weapon attacks as your Violent Ki mod; or Ki barrier, whichever is higher.

name: Viscous Ki
description: Damage inflicted by your ki leaves deep wounds that heal much slower than usual.
benefit: Bleed effects last twice as long. Any heal check made within 24 hours of the injury has a +5 higher DC. Fast healing is disabled for one round per damage done. Reduce any form of healing by your Violent Ki Mod or Ki Barrier for one full round after damaging a target. Violent Ki and Ultimate Ki Barriers damage is increased by 3.

name: Improved Viscous Ki
description: Your ki prevents wounds from healing. It festers, blocking even the miracles of the gods and ancient magics. (T)
benefit: Reduce any form of healing from attacks you personally inflict by ½+your Violent Ki Mod or Ki Barrier Mod whichever is higher for one hour. Additionally, the target gains a +5 to the DC of any heal checks for 24 hours after injury.

name: Ki Healing
description: You can manipulate others ki to heal rather than destroy
benefit: You can as a Full Round action heal for lethal damage=Ki Mod or Nonlethal=Ki Mod*2, can be used to heal other Ki users within reach. Additionally allows you to transfer as much Ki as a target can hold within reach (must be willing). Requires use of 1 Ki to heal others. Can be used a number of times per day for free equal to Character Level, subsequent use requires 1 Ki.

name: Unbreakable
description: Your Equipment is built as hardy as they come but more importantly you know how to utilize it to its best potential
prerequisites: Armor Focus and or Shield Focus
benefit: Increase typed armor/shield bonus DR by 50% (to 100%). Only usable for worn armor/shield. Must take armor and shield individually.

name: All Purpose Defenses
description: Bypassing your equipment's defenses is no simple task.
prerequisites: Armor Focus and or Shield Focus; Natural Armor of 10+
benefit: DR granted by Typed Armor applies half of its total against the damage it is weak to. This feat only applies to one type (Armor, Shield, or Natural). You may take this feat multiple times. *If you had 10/Bludgeoning log the feat DR as 5/All Purpose (B) right after the Bludgeoning entry.

name: Strength of a Warrior
description: Your muscle bound body shirks off blows with ease, your tough hide and muscles deflect arrows like thick armor.
prerequisites: Base Attack Bonus +1, Strength OR Constitution 20+
benefit: You add either your Strength or Constitution modifier to your natural armor class. Your newly added modifier doesn't take the place of the Dex Modifier.
special: The AC bonus gain from this feat is retained even when flat-footed. This feat can be taken twice, first time adding one of the bonuses, either Strength or Constitution, then adding the other one.

name: Dauntless Frame
description: Countless days spent training have given you a physique like no other.
benefit: For every point of strength modifier, add a +1 to Max Dex on any armor.
normal: A Paladin wearing Full Plate would usually receive a +1 Dex bonus to their AC
special: With this feat, a Paladin with a Strength of 16 wearing Full Plate would have a Max Dex bonus of +4 to their AC.

name: Mindscape
description: Psionics are at their core a manipulation of the mind. With a bit of effort, the equivalent of a demiplane, albeit much more limited, is possible.
prerequisites: Psionic Class of at least 8th level
benefit: You may create a Minor Mindscape https://www.d20pfsrd.com/magic/all-spells/c/create-mindscape/ As detailed https://www.d20pfsrd.com/alternative-rule-systems/occult-adventures/occult-rules/mindscapes/ When taking this feat you must choose between Unconscious entry or Conscious Entry. You can take it a second time to get both, but only one may be active at a time. Unconscious Entry requires a target to be unconscious or completely disabled. This method can force up to one being per Psionic Class Levels with a mind into the mindscape within range of your Psionic Abilities. You must have already marked or be aware of the target unless the conditions of your mindscapes entry are tied to the area they are in or they have activated an entry trigger. Conscious Entry requires a target to enter through set conditions or willingly. This must be specific and appropriate for the traits of the mindscape. If trying to force someone who has triggered the conditions to enter a mindscape who is actively resisting they must roll a Will Save DC=10+Psionic Stat+Psionic Level/2. For abilities that increase the DC treat this as a Psionic Power. For every Power Point expended increase the DC by 1. To resist a target must know they are entering a mindscape.

name: Greater Mindscape
description: As your Psionic Power grows so does your mindscape
prerequisites: Psionic Class of at least 12th level
benefit: You may create a Greater Mindscape https://www.d20pfsrd.com/magic/all-spells/c/create-mindscape/ As detailed https://www.d20pfsrd.com/alternative-rule-systems/occult-adventures/occult-rules/mindscapes/ This Mindscape automatically becomes permanent as it is connected to your mind. You can re-establish it to move locations or change conditions. When re-established anyone currently inside is freed. If you choose Unconscious Entry targets cannot be woken up through natural means, they must exit your mindscape by defeating the creator or through the designated exit. If you choose Conscious Entry you no longer need to be in your own Mindscape for others to occupy or enter it. You are aware of anyone entering or leaving despite not being present.

name: Instigate Psychic Duel
description: A combined mindscape created through the link of multiple Psychics.
benefit: You can start a Psychic Duel for 2 Power Points. If you both agree to the duel you can both spend one Power Point. https://www.d20pfsrd.com/magic/all-spells/i/instigate-psychic-duel/ Additionally, if you know you are in another Psychics mindscape you can force them into a Psychic Duel for 2 Power Points. If they are not present within it, you pull them in for an additional 4.

name: Psychic Combatant
description: Even when your mind is elsewhere your body does everything it can to protect itself.
benefit: When in a mindscape, disabled, or asleep, you can take defensive actions and retain your dex to AC. You can use abilities that are defensive in nature but you cannot attack or perform any complicated actions.

name: Quick Action
description: Your reflexes are honed to the point that you can act much faster than those around you.
benefit: On extra turns you gain a move action rather than a swift.

name: Quick Action (Mythic)
description: An instant is all you need.
benefit: On extra turns you gain a standard action rather than a move.

name: Hard to Shake Off
description: Faster Opponents have a difficult time acting when you are focused on them.
benefit: You can negate one extra turn per round against an enemy that you threaten. This refreshes when the round refreshes and if you stop threatening at any point during the round they get the extra turn back. An opponent can still take their extra turn if they accept an AOO by the holder of this feat. If the attack from this provocation hits and does damage, the action is lost.

name: Hard to Shake Off (Mythic)
description: Those around you cannot act freely without threat of your intervention.
benefit: You can negate a turn against every enemy you threaten instead of just one. To do so, you must either expend a mythic charge to gain this benefit for a number of rounds equal to your Mythic Rank, or Martial Focus to gain this benefit for 1 round.

name: Battlefield Intuition (Combat)
description: Your keen wit improves your reaction time.
benefit: You add your Wisdom modifier to initiative checks. This is in addition to other modifiers to initiative checks, like the bonus provided by a high Dexterity score or the Improved Initiative feat.

name: Presence of Mind (Combat)
description: The depths of your knowledge improve your reaction time.
benefit: You add your Intelligence modifier to initiative checks. This is in addition to other modifiers to initiative checks, like the bonus provided by a high Dexterity or the Improved Initiative feat.

name: Muscle Reaction (Combat)
description: Your muscles are always tense, ready to start swinging.
benefit: You add your Strength modifier to initiative checks. This is in addition to other modifiers to initiative checks, like the bonus provided by a high Dexterity or the Improved Initiative feat. This does not include any strength provided due to size.

name: Improved Initiative (Combat)
description: Your quick reflexes allow you to react rapidly to danger.
benefit: You get a +4 bonus on initiative checks.

name: Improved Initiative (Mythic)
description: You leap into the fray with speed and confidence.
benefit: The bonus on initiative checks granted by Improved Initiative increases by an amount equal to your tier. This bonus stacks with the bonus from Improved Initiative. In addition, instead of rolling initiative, you can expend one use of mythic power to treat your roll as a natural 20.

name: Double Down
benefit: Double permanent E-Kat acquisition.

name: Stream of luck
benefit: Gain one E-Kat per session (Character played), two if you have double down.

name: Sweet Dreams
benefit: Gain one E-Kat per in-game long rest, two if you have double down. (Applies once to timeskips longer than a day)

name: Lucky Boy
benefit: E-Kat (roll based) bonuses are doubled

name: Very Lucky Boy
benefit: E-Kat (roll based) bonuses are increased to triple.

name: Ass pull
benefit: Gain 4 E-Kats per session that expire upon the sessions end, and a +4 Luck

name: It Just Works
benefit: Gain one free Hero Point per session that expire upon the sessions end, +4 Luck

name: Middle Finger
benefit: Gain 1 E-Kat anytime the GM has a hostile NPC utilize a Hero Point.

name: Right of Deferment
benefit: You may wait to apply E-Kats after a roll for no penalty.

name: Luck God
benefit: All E-Kat costs (excluding the 99 tier and Purchasing new Luck Traits) are cut in half, additionally you gain a +2 bonus to all saves, attacks, ability checks, skill checks, AC, and Caster Level Checks. You gain a +4 Luck, and once per day can force a reroll in your favor on anything even if not present as long as it benefits you, upon which you can choose which roll you prefer.

name: Adept Initiator (Champion, Combat)
description: You simplify and streamline your intricate performances.
prerequisites: Knowledge of at least one technique.
benefit: Reduce the complexity of all techniques you know by 1 for the purpose of your initiation of them.

name: Burning Technique (Champion, Combat)
description: You suffer to perform immensely powerful techniques.
prerequisites: Knowledge of at least one technique.
benefit: In addition to the normal methods of paying for a technique’s complexity cost, you may choose to pay for complexity by taking ability burn to an ability score of your choice (Chosen when the feat is taken). Every 1 points of ability burn that you take pays for 1 point of complexity. Ability burn functions as ability damage, save that it can only be healed by resting for 8 hours.

name: Companion Techniques (Champion, Combat)
description: You share the intricacies of your combat lore with your closest allies.
prerequisites: Knowledge of at least one technique, must have the Conjuration sphere, an animal companion, or some similar ability that grants a companion.
benefit: Choose an animal companion, Conjuration sphere companion, or other companion you have as a result of some ability. It learns any techniques you do. In addition, when learning or crafting techniques, you have access to any talents your companion has, even if it is not currently summoned.
special: You may take this feat multiple times. Each time, you select a different companion.

name: Coordinated Initiation (Champion, Teamwork)
description: You and your allies can amplify your abilities when coordinating.
prerequisites: Knowledge of at least one technique.
benefit: When multiple characters work together to perform a multi-character technique and all of them possess this feat, the technique’s complexity is reduced by 3 for each participant beyond the first rather than 2.

name: Extensive Technique Study (Champion, Combat)
description: You possess extensive experience with the lore of techniques. (T1)
benefit: Increase the maximum number of techniques you are capable of knowing at one time by 4.
special: You may select this feat multiple times.

name: Group Initiation (Champion, Combat, Teamwork)
description: When you aid in a technique, you may also perform it yourself.
prerequisites: Knowledge of at least one technique.
benefit: When multiple characters work together to perform a multi-character technique and all of them possess this feat, they may choose to increase the technique’s complexity by 3. If they do, every character who worked together to initiate the technique may perform the technique’s action (for example, each member would charge when using Fire Tackle).

name: Improved Assistance (Champion, Combat)
description: You add a bit of extra aid when coordinating a technique.
prerequisites: Knowledge of at least one technique.
benefit: When you initiate a multi-character technique where you do not perform the action, you may attempt the aid another action on the character performing the action as part of the action to initiate the technique. So long as you are in range to initiate the technique, you do not need to be in the normal range to aid another. If you possess the Circle Casting feat, you may maintain that feat’s effects on the target so long as you are within range of the technique (rather than 30 feet).

name: Ready Initiation (Champion, Combat, Teamwork)
description: When one of your allies primes a technique, you respond immediately.
prerequisites: Knowledge of at least one technique.
benefit: When multiple characters with this feat work together to initiate a multi-character technique, the technique is performed on the highest of the participants’ initiative counts rather than the lowest. All participants have their actions for the turn moved up to the initiative count where the technique is performed.

name: Technique Prowess (Combat)
description: Your martial skills enable incredible technique usage.
prerequisites: Base attack bonus +5, knowledge of at least one technique.
benefit: When you expend martial focus to pay for the complexity cost of a technique that uses no magical spheres, the amount of the complexity cost paid by expending martial focus increases by 1 for every five points of base attack bonus you possess.

name: True Calling
description: You have found a vocation where you can truly shine, natural talent and hard work place you among the best in your field.
benefit: The natural Profession cap is extended to 15 in one qualifying profession. You may only take this once.

name: Multi Talented
description: You have a variety of interests and/or jobs, but your talents are spread wide without suffering from lack of focus.
benefit: Your profession rank cap is increased by 10. You may take this feat multiple times up to once every additional 10 levels.

name: Always Improving
description: Your extensive life experience may lend itself well to your chosen vocation.
prerequisites: True Calling; May only select when you have reached +15 in a Profession
benefit: You can now spend skill ranks in the profession you selected with True Calling.

name: Agile
benefit: You get a +2 bonus on all Balance checks and Escape Artist checks.

name: Diligent
benefit: You get a +2 bonus on all Appraise checks and Decipher Script checks.

name: Extra Turning
prerequisites: Ability to turn or rebuke creatures.
benefit: Each time you take this feat, you can use your ability to turn or rebuke creatures four more times per day than normal. If you have the ability to turn or rebuke more than one kind of creature each of your turning or rebuking abilities gains four additional uses per day.
normal: Without this feat, a character can typically turn or rebuke undead (or other creatures) a number of times per day equal to 3 + his or her Charisma modifier.
special: You can gain Extra Turning multiple times. Its effects stack. Each time you take the feat, you can use each of your turning or rebuking abilities four additional times per day.

name: Improved Turning
prerequisites: Ability to turn or rebuke creatures.
benefit: You turn or rebuke creatures as if you were one level higher than you are in the class that grants you the ability.

name: Investigator
benefit: You get a +2 bonus on all Gather Information checks and Search checks.

name: Negotiator
benefit: You get a +2 bonus on all Diplomacy checks and Sense Motive checks.

name: Nimble Fingers
benefit: You get a +2 bonus on all Disable Device checks and Open Lock checks.

name: Track
benefit: To find tracks or to follow them for 1 mile requires a successful Survival check. You must make another Survival check every time the tracks become difficult to follow. You move at half your normal speed (or at your normal speed with a -5 penalty on the check, or at up to twice your normal speed with a -20 penalty on the check). The DC depends on the surface and the prevailing conditions, as given on Table: Track DC .
normal: Without this feat, you can use the Survival skill to find tracks, but you can follow them only if the DC for the task is 10 or lower. Alternatively, you can use the Search skill to find a footprint or similar sign of a creature’s passage using the DCs given above, but you can’t use Search to follow tracks, even if someone else has already found them.
special: A ranger automatically has Track as a bonus feat. He need not select it. This feat does not allow you to find or follow the tracks made by a subject of a pass without trace spell.
